records.definition: سلب حرية الأشخاص وحبسهم في أماكن محددة خلال النزاعات المسلحة، وفقًا لضوابط القانون الدولي الإنساني التي تكفل المعاملة الإنسانية للمحتجزين.
records.english_definition: Depriving persons of their liberty and confining them in specific places during armed conflicts, in accordance with the rules of international humanitarian law that guarantee the humane treatment of detainees.

translations.word: Detention|Depriving persons of their liberty and confining them in specific places during armed conflicts, in accordance with the rules of international humanitarian law that guarantee the humane treatment of detainees.

records.definition: الالتزام بأعلى معايير الجودة والكفاءة المهنية في أداء المهام الإنسانية والإغاثية، واستخدام أفضل الممارسات المعترف بها دوليًّا.
records.english_definition: The commitment to the highest standards of quality and professional competence in the performance of humanitarian and relief duties, and the use of internationally recognized best practices.

translations.word: Professionalism|The commitment to the highest standards of quality and professional competence in the performance of humanitarian and relief duties, and the use of internationally recognized best practices.

records.definition: الالتزام بتقدير واحترام القيم والتقاليد والممارسات الثقافية المحلية للمجتمعات المتضررة، وإدماجها في تصميم وتنفيذ البرامج الإنسانية، مع ضمان عدم تعارضها مع حقوق الإنسان الأساسية والمعايير الإنسانية الدولية.
records.english_definition: The commitment to valuing and respecting the local cultural values, traditions, and practices of affected communities, and integrating them into the design and implementation of humanitarian programs, while ensuring that they do not conflict with fundamental human rights and international humanitarian standards.

translations.word: Respect for Cultures and Customs|The commitment to valuing and respecting the local cultural values, traditions, and practices of affected communities, and integrating them into the design and implementation of humanitarian programs, while ensuring that they do not conflict with fundamental human rights and international humanitarian standards.

records.definition: المتطلبات الأساسية الضرورية لبقاء الإنسان وكرامته، كالغذاء والماء والمأوى والرعاية الصحية، في سياق الأزمات.
records.english_definition: The essential requirements for human survival and dignity — such as food, water, shelter, and health care — in the context of crises.

translations.word: Humanitarian Needs|The essential requirements for human survival and dignity — such as food, water, shelter, and health care — in the context of crises.

records.definition: متابعة أداء الأفراد والمؤسسات وتقييمه وتحسينه لتحقيق الأهداف المحددة.
records.english_definition: Monitoring, evaluating, and improving the performance of individuals and organizations to achieve set goals.

translations.word: Performance Management|Monitoring, evaluating, and improving the performance of individuals and organizations to achieve set goals.

records.definition: نهج إداري يركِّز على تحسين الجودة في جميع جوانب منظمة ما؛ لتحقيق الفاعلية، ورضاء العملاء.
records.english_definition: A management approach focused on improving quality across all aspects of an organization to achieve effectiveness and customer satisfaction.

translations.word: Total Quality Management (TQM)|A management approach focused on improving quality across all aspects of an organization to achieve effectiveness and customer satisfaction.

records.definition: آليات تعديل السياسات واللوائح بما يتماشى مع التطورات والمتغيرات.
records.english_definition: Mechanisms for amending policies and regulations in line with developments and changes.

translations.word: Governance Management|Mechanisms for amending policies and regulations in line with developments and changes.

records.definition: ضمان توافر النقد الكافي لوفاء شركة ما أو نحوها بالتزاماتها المالية عند الاستحقاق.
records.english_definition: Ensuring that sufficient cash is available for a company or similar entity to meet its financial obligations as they fall due.

translations.word: Liquidity Management|Ensuring that sufficient cash is available for a company or similar entity to meet its financial obligations as they fall due.

records.definition: عملية تحديد  وتقييم  ومراقبة وتخفيف المخاطر التي قد تؤثر على تحقيق الأهداف.
records.english_definition: The process of identifying, assessing, monitoring, and mitigating risks that may impact the achievement of objectives.

translations.word: Risk Management|The process of identifying, assessing, monitoring, and mitigating risks that may impact the achievement of objectives.

records.definition: عملية تحديد وتقييم وإدارة المخاطر التي قد تؤثر على أموال الصندوق وأهدافه.
records.english_definition: Identifying, assessing, and managing risks that may affect the fund’s assets and objectives.

translations.word: Fund Risk Management|Identifying, assessing, and managing risks that may affect the fund’s assets and objectives.

records.definition: تنظيم وتنسيق تخزين المنتجات للحفاظ على توافرها وتجنب النقص أو الفائض.
records.english_definition: Organizing and coordinating the storage of products to maintain availability and avoid shortages or excess.

translations.word: Inventory Management|Organizing and coordinating the storage of products to maintain availability and avoid shortages or excess.

records.definition: جمع وتخزين وتوزيع المعرفة بطريقة تعزِّز الكفاءة المؤسسية.
records.english_definition: Collection, storage, and dissemination of knowledge to enhance organizational efficiency.

translations.word: Knowledge Management|Collection, storage, and dissemination of knowledge to enhance organizational efficiency.

records.definition: عملية جمع وتخزين وتحليل ومشاركة البيانات والمعلومات بطريقة منهجية ومنسقة لدعم اتخاذ القرارات الإنسانية القائمة على الأدلة وتحسين فعالية الاستجابة وضمان التنسيق الأمثل بين مختلف الجهات الفاعلة.
records.english_definition: The process of collecting, storing, analyzing, and sharing data and information in a systematic and coordinated manner to support evidence-based humanitarian decision-making, improve the effectiveness of the response, and ensure optimal coordination among the various actors.

translations.word: Humanitarian Information Management|The process of collecting, storing, analyzing, and sharing data and information in a systematic and coordinated manner to support evidence-based humanitarian decision-making, improve the effectiveness of the response, and ensure optimal coordination among the various actors.

records.definition: إدارة الموارد الطبيعية مثل الأرض والمياه والغابات لضمان استخدامها المستدام.
records.english_definition: The management of natural resources like land, water, and forests to ensure their sustainable use.

translations.word: Natural Resource Management|The management of natural resources like land, water, and forests to ensure their sustainable use.

records.definition: تخطيط وتطوير وتوزيع واستخدام الموارد المائية بشكل مستدام.
records.english_definition: The planning, development, distribution, and sustainable use of water resources

translations.word: Water Management|The planning, development, distribution, and sustainable use of water resources

records.definition: جمع ونقل ومعالجة والتخلص من النفايات بطرق تقلل من تأثيرها على البيئة.
records.english_definition: The collection, transport, processing, and disposal of waste in ways that minimize environmental impact.

translations.word: Waste Management|The collection, transport, processing, and disposal of waste in ways that minimize environmental impact.

records.definition: تنسيق وإدارة جميع الأنشطة المتعلقة بتدفق السلع والخدمات والمعلومات.
records.english_definition: Coordinating and managing all activities related to the flow of goods, services, and information.

translations.word: Supply Chain Management (SCM)|Coordinating and managing all activities related to the flow of goods, services, and information.

records.definition: عمليات وإجراءات لإنهاء النزاعات المسلحة، وبناء أسس مستدامة للسلام والاستقرار.
records.english_definition: Processes and measures for ending armed conflicts and building sustainable foundations for peace and stability.

translations.word: Peacemaking|Processes and measures for ending armed conflicts and building sustainable foundations for peace and stability.

records.definition: حالات طارئة تهدد حياة الإنسان وسلامته وكرامته، ناجمة عن كوارث طبيعية أو نزاعات مسلحة أو أوبئة، تتطلب استجابة إنسانية عاجلة.
records.english_definition: Emergency situations that threaten human life, safety, and dignity, arising from natural disasters, armed conflicts, or epidemics, and requiring an urgent humanitarian response.

translations.word: Humanitarian Crises|Emergency situations that threaten human life, safety, and dignity, arising from natural disasters, armed conflicts, or epidemics, and requiring an urgent humanitarian response.

records.definition: حالات طوارئ تستمر لفترات ممتدة، وتتطلب استجابة إنسانية طويلة المدى والربط بين الإغاثة والتنمية.
records.english_definition: Emergency situations that persist for extended periods, requiring a long-term humanitarian response and the linking of relief to development.

translations.word: Protracted Crises|Emergency situations that persist for extended periods, requiring a long-term humanitarian response and the linking of relief to development.

records.definition: حالات نقص حاد في الغذاء تهدد حياة السكان، وتتطلب تدخلًا إنسانيًّا عاجلًا لمنع المجاعة.
records.english_definition: Situations of acute food shortage that threaten the lives of populations and require urgent humanitarian intervention to prevent famine.

translations.word: Food Crises|Situations of acute food shortage that threaten the lives of populations and require urgent humanitarian intervention to prevent famine.

records.definition: تهديدات وتحديات إنسانية محتملة  تتطلب التأهب والتخطيط المسبق لمواجهتها بفعالية.
records.english_definition: Potential humanitarian threats and challenges that require preparedness and advance planning to confront them effectively.

translations.word: Future Crises|Potential humanitarian threats and challenges that require preparedness and advance planning to confront them effectively.

records.definition: حالة طوارئ إنسانية ممتدة زمنيًّا تتسم بتعقيدات سياسية وأمنية واقتصادية تعوق الحلول السريعة، وتتطلب استجابة طويلة الأمد.
records.english_definition: A protracted humanitarian emergency characterized by political, security, and economic complexities that impede rapid solutions, and requiring a long-term response.

translations.word: Intractable Crisis|A protracted humanitarian emergency characterized by political, security, and economic complexities that impede rapid solutions, and requiring a long-term response.

records.definition: مجموعة الإجراءات والأنشطة المتخذة لمواجهة احتياجات السكان المتضررين من كارثة أو أزمة.
records.english_definition: The set of measures and activities undertaken to address the needs of populations affected by a disaster or crisis.

translations.word: Humanitarian Response|The set of measures and activities undertaken to address the needs of populations affected by a disaster or crisis.

records.definition: التدخل السريع والمنسَّق لتقديم المساعدات الإنسانية العاجلة في أعقاب وقوع كارثة أو أزمة؛ لتلبية الاحتياجات الأساسية الفورية للمتضررين.
records.english_definition: The rapid, coordinated intervention to deliver urgent humanitarian assistance in the aftermath of a disaster or crisis, in order to meet the immediate basic needs of those affected.

translations.word: Emergency Response|The rapid, coordinated intervention to deliver urgent humanitarian assistance in the aftermath of a disaster or crisis, in order to meet the immediate basic needs of those affected.

records.definition: تدخل إنساني متكامل بين مختلف الجهات الفاعلة لتجنب الازدواجية، وسد الثغرات، وتحقيق أقصى أثر إيجابي.
records.english_definition: An integrated humanitarian intervention among the various actors to avoid duplication, fill gaps, and achieve the greatest positive impact.

translations.word: Coordinated Response|An integrated humanitarian intervention among the various actors to avoid duplication, fill gaps, and achieve the greatest positive impact.

records.definition: خطة تحدد الكيفية التي سينتهي بها الدعم الخارجي أو سينتقل تدريجياً، بما يضمن استدامة نتائج التدخل التنموي واستمرار المنافع بعد انتهاء التنفيذ.
records.english_definition: A plan that defines how external support will be phased out or transferred while ensuring the sustainability of development results and continued benefits after implementation ends.

translations.word: Exit Strategy |  A plan that defines how external support will be phased out or transferred while ensuring the sustainability of development results and continued benefits after implementation ends.

records.definition: كمية الطاقة المستخدمة من قِبل الأفراد أو المؤسسات أو الدول.
records.english_definition: The amount of energy used by individuals, organizations, or countries.

translations.word: Energy Consumption|The amount of energy used by individuals, organizations, or countries.

records.definition: كمية المياه المستخدمة في الأنشطة المختلفة مثل الزراعة والصناعة والاستخدام المنزلي.
records.english_definition: The amount of water used in various activities like agriculture, industry, and domestic use.

translations.word: Water Consumption|The amount of water used in various activities like agriculture, industry, and domestic use.

records.definition: الرعاية الطبية الفورية والأساسية التي تُقدَّم للمصاب أو المريض في موقع الحادث قبل وصول الطواقم الطبية المتخصصة، بهدف الحفاظ على حياته، ومنع تدهور حالته، وتخفيف آلامه، حتى نقله إلى مرفق صحي مناسب.
records.english_definition: The immediate, basic medical care provided to an injured or sick person at the scene of the incident before the arrival of specialized medical teams, with the aim of preserving their life, preventing the deterioration of their condition, and relieving their pain until they are transferred to an appropriate health facility.

translations.word: First Aid|The immediate, basic medical care provided to an injured or sick person at the scene of the incident before the arrival of specialized medical teams, with the aim of preserving their life, preventing the deterioration of their condition, and relieving their pain until they are transferred to an appropriate health facility.

records.definition: نقل المصابين أو المرضى جوًّا بطائرات أو مروحيات مجهزة طبيًّا من مناطق الكوارث أو النزاعات إلى مرافق صحية متقدمة، أو إيصال الإمدادات الطبية والفرق الطبية الطارئة إلى المناطق النائية أو المحاصرة التي يتعذر الوصول إليها برًّا.
records.english_definition: The transport of the injured or sick by air, using medically equipped aircraft or helicopters, from disaster or conflict areas to advanced health facilities, or the delivery of medical supplies and emergency medical teams to remote or besieged areas that cannot be reached by land.

translations.word: Air Ambulance|The transport of the injured or sick by air, using medically equipped aircraft or helicopters, from disaster or conflict areas to advanced health facilities, or the delivery of medical supplies and emergency medical teams to remote or besieged areas that cannot be reached by land.

records.definition: مبادرة دولية تضع معايير دنيا في الاستجابة الإنسانية لضمان جودة وفعالية المساعدات وحماية كرامة المتضررين.
records.english_definition: An international initiative that sets minimum standards in humanitarian response to ensure the quality and effectiveness of assistance and protect the dignity of those affected.

translations.word: Sphere|An international initiative that sets minimum standards in humanitarian response to ensure the quality and effectiveness of assistance and protect the dignity of those affected.

records.definition: الأفراد أو المجموعات التي تتأثر أو تؤثر في قرارات المؤسسة وأنشطتها.
records.english_definition: Individuals or groups affected by or affecting organizational decisions and activities.

translations.word: Stakeholders|Individuals or groups affected by or affecting organizational decisions and activities.

records.definition: جميع الجهات والأفراد الذين لديهم مصلحة في أنشطة  الصندوق وأدائه.
records.english_definition: All entities and individuals with an interest in the fund’s activities and performance.

translations.word: Fund Stakeholders|All entities and individuals with an interest in the fund’s activities and performance.

records.definition: عملية استعادة الأراضي المتدهورة أو غير الصالحة للاستخدام وتحسينها للاستخدام الزراعي أو التنموي.
records.english_definition: The process of restoring degraded or unusable land and improving it for agricultural or developmental use.

translations.word: Land Reclamation|The process of restoring degraded or unusable land and improving it for agricultural or developmental use.

records.definition: التغييرات التي تهدف إلى تحسين نظام التعليم من حيث الجودة والوصول والمساواة.
records.english_definition: Changes aimed at improving the education system in terms of quality, access, and equity.

translations.word: Education Reform|Changes aimed at improving the education system in terms of quality, access, and equity.

records.definition: أداة تخطيط وإدارة تعرض بصورة منهجية التسلسل المنطقي للنتائج المتوقعة، ومؤشرات قياسها، ووسائل التحقق، والافتراضات التي يقوم عليها التدخل التنموي.
records.english_definition: A planning and management tool that systematically presents the logical sequence of expected results, their indicators, means of verification, and underlying assumptions for a development intervention.

translations.word: Results Framework| A planning and management tool that systematically presents the logical sequence of expected results, their indicators, means of verification, and underlying assumptions for a development intervention.

records.definition: الدول الموقعة على الاتفاقيات الدولية الإنسانية، مثل اتفاقيات جنيف، والتي تلتزم بتطبيق بنود هذه الاتفاقيات واحترام القانون الدولي الإنساني.
records.english_definition: The states that have signed international humanitarian conventions, such as the Geneva Conventions, and that are committed to implementing the provisions of these conventions and respecting international humanitarian law.

translations.word: High Contracting Parties|The states that have signed international humanitarian conventions, such as the Geneva Conventions, and that are committed to implementing the provisions of these conventions and respecting international humanitarian law.

records.definition: عملية إعادة بناء وتأهيل البنية التحتية والمرافق العامة والمساكن والخدمات الأساسية المدمَّرة جراء النزاعات أو الكوارث؛ بهدف استعادة الحياة الطبيعية، وتمكين المجتمعات المتضررة من العودة إلى سبل عيشها المستدامة.
records.english_definition: The process of rebuilding and rehabilitating the infrastructure, public facilities, housing, and essential services destroyed by conflicts or disasters, with the aim of restoring normal life and enabling affected communities to return to their sustainable livelihoods.

translations.word: Reconstruction|The process of rebuilding and rehabilitating the infrastructure, public facilities, housing, and essential services destroyed by conflicts or disasters, with the aim of restoring normal life and enabling affected communities to return to their sustainable livelihoods.

records.definition: عملية استعادة القدرات والخدمات الأساسية للأفراد والمجتمعات المتضررة وتحسينها؛ بهدف تمكينهم من العودة إلى حياتهم الطبيعية، أو تحسين ظروفهم المعيشية.
records.english_definition: The process of restoring and improving the essential capacities and services of affected individuals and communities, with the aim of enabling them to return to their normal lives or to improve their living conditions.

translations.word: Rehabilitation|The process of restoring and improving the essential capacities and services of affected individuals and communities, with the aim of enabling them to return to their normal lives or to improve their living conditions.

records.definition: تأهيل الأفراد لتولي مناصب قيادية في المستقبل.
records.english_definition: Preparing individuals for future leadership positions.

translations.word: Future Leaders Preparation|Preparing individuals for future leadership positions.

records.definition: الجهود والمساهمات التي يقدمها الأفراد من وقتهم ومهاراتهم وخبراتهم بشكل طوعي دون مقابل مادي خدمةً للمجتمع ومساعدةً للمحتاجين، انطلاقًا من شعور بالمسؤولية الاجتماعية والرغبة في إحداث تأثير إيجابي في حياة الآخرين.
records.english_definition: The efforts and contributions that individuals voluntarily make of their time, skills, and expertise, without financial compensation, in service of the community and in aid of those in need, out of a sense of social responsibility and a desire to make a positive difference in the lives of others.

translations.word: Voluntary Work|The efforts and contributions that individuals voluntarily make of their time, skills, and expertise, without financial compensation, in service of the community and in aid of those in need, out of a sense of social responsibility and a desire to make a positive difference in the lives of others.

records.definition: المساعدات الفورية المقدمة لتلبية الاحتياجات الأساسية المُلِحَّة للمتضررين من كارثة أو أزمة.
records.english_definition: The immediate assistance provided to meet the pressing basic needs of those affected by a disaster or crisis.

translations.word: Emergency Relief|The immediate assistance provided to meet the pressing basic needs of those affected by a disaster or crisis.

records.definition: المساعدات الإنسانية التي تحقق أهدافها المرجوة بكفاءة عالية، وتلبي الاحتياجات الحقيقية للمستفيدين في الوقت المناسب وبالجودة المطلوبة، مع الاستخدام الأمثل للموارد المتاحة، وتُحْدِث أثرًا إيجابيًّا ملموسًا على حياة المتضررين وتعافي المجتمعات.
records.english_definition: Humanitarian assistance that achieves its intended objectives with high efficiency, meets the real needs of beneficiaries at the right time and with the required quality, makes optimal use of the available resources, and has a tangible positive impact on the lives of affected people and the recovery of communities.

translations.word: Effective Relief|Humanitarian assistance that achieves its intended objectives with high efficiency, meets the real needs of beneficiaries at the right time and with the required quality, makes optimal use of the available resources, and has a tangible positive impact on the lives of affected people and the recovery of communities.

records.definition: عملية خلق أفكار جديدة وتطوير أفكار أو منتجات أو عمليات جديدة تسهم في التغيير والتحسين.
records.english_definition: Developing new ideas, products, or processes that contribute to change and improvement.

translations.word: Innovation|Developing new ideas, products, or processes that contribute to change and improvement.

records.definition: تطوير حلول جديدة للمشكلات الاجتماعية بهدف تحسين رفاهية الأفراد والمجتمعات.
records.english_definition: Developing new solutions to social problems aiming to improve the well-being of individuals and communities.

translations.word: Social Innovation|Developing new solutions to social problems aiming to improve the well-being of individuals and communities.

records.definition: دمج التقنية مع الابتكار الاجتماعي لحل المشكلات المجتمعية بطرق مستدامة.
records.english_definition: Integrating technology with social innovation to solve societal problems sustainably.

translations.word: Socio-Technical Innovation|Integrating technology with social innovation to solve societal problems sustainably.

records.definition: تطوير تقنيات وممارسات جديدة تهدف إلى تقليل التأثيرات البيئية السلبية وتعزيز الاستدامة.
records.english_definition: Developing new technologies and practices aimed at reducing negative environmental impacts and promoting sustainability.

translations.word: Environmental Innovation|Developing new technologies and practices aimed at reducing negative environmental impacts and promoting sustainability.

records.definition: تطوير تقنيات جديدة أو تحسين تقنيات حالية لتلبية احتياجات المجتمع بشكل أفضل.
records.english_definition: Developing new technologies or improving existing ones to better meet societal needs.

translations.word: Technological Innovation|Developing new technologies or improving existing ones to better meet societal needs.

records.definition: تطوير حلول تقنية تلبي الاحتياجات الحالية دون التأثير سلبًا على الأجيال القادمة.
records.english_definition: Developing technological solutions that meet current needs without harming future generations.

translations.word: Sustainable Innovation|Developing technological solutions that meet current needs without harming future generations.

records.definition: إستراتيجية تسعى إلى تطوير أفكار جديدة وحلول إبداعية؛ وذلك عن طريق الاستفادة من مصادر داخلية وخارجية.
records.english_definition: A strategy that seeks to develop new ideas and creative solutions by drawing on both internal and external sources.

translations.word: Open Innovation|A strategy that seeks to develop new ideas and creative solutions by drawing on both internal and external sources.

records.definition: تعزيز ثقافة الإبداع، وتبني الأفكار الجديدة الهادفة داخل المؤسسات، بما يسهم في قدرتها التنافسية.
records.english_definition: Fostering a culture of creativity and adopting purposeful new ideas within organizations, thereby enhancing their competitiveness.

translations.word: Institutional Innovation|Fostering a culture of creativity and adopting purposeful new ideas within organizations, thereby enhancing their competitiveness.

records.definition: إنتاجُ رؤى وحلول معرفية جديدة، أو إعادةُ توظيف المعارف القائمة بأساليب غير مسبوقة، بما يُعزّز فاعلية التدخلات واستدامة أثرها.
records.english_definition: The generation of new insights and knowledge-based solutions, or the repurposing of existing knowledge in unprecedented ways, so as to enhance the effectiveness of interventions and the sustainability of their impact.

translations.word: Knowledge Innovation|The generation of new insights and knowledge-based solutions, or the repurposing of existing knowledge in unprecedented ways, so as to enhance the effectiveness of interventions and the sustainability of their impact.

records.definition: إنتاج أعمال جديدة ومبتكرة تعبر عن المفاهيم والقيم الثقافية.
records.english_definition: Producing new and innovative works that express cultural concepts and values.

translations.word: Artistic Creativity|Producing new and innovative works that express cultural concepts and values.

records.definition: معاهدات بين الدول تنظم العلاقات والمصالح المشتركة.
records.english_definition: Treaties or accords between countries regulating relations and shared interests.

translations.word: International Agreements|Treaties or accords between countries regulating relations and shared interests.

records.english_definition: Cooperation and coordination between local and international humanitarian actors to improve the effectiveness of the humanitarian response.

translations.word: International Partnership|Cooperation and coordination between local and international humanitarian actors to improve the effectiveness of the humanitarian response.

records.definition: علاقة تعاون إستراتيجية ومتكافئة بين المنظمات الدولية والجهات المحلية، ترتكز على المسؤولية المشتركة وتقاسم القرار والموارد لتعزيز فعالية الاستجابة واستدامتها.
records.english_definition: A strategic, equitable cooperative relationship between international organizations and local actors, based on shared responsibility and the sharing of decision-making and resources, to enhance the effectiveness and sustainability of the response.

translations.word: Local Partnership|A strategic, equitable cooperative relationship between international organizations and local actors, based on shared responsibility and the sharing of decision-making and resources, to enhance the effectiveness and sustainability of the response.

records.definition: المؤسسات والشركات الوطنية العاملة في البلد المستفيد التي يُتعاقَد معها لتوريد السلع أو تقديم الخدمات أو تنفيذ الأعمال اللازمة للبرامج الإنسانية، بما يعزِّز الشراكة المحلية، ويدعم الاقتصاد الوطني، ويضمن استمرارية الخدمات.
records.english_definition: National institutions and companies operating in the beneficiary country that are contracted to supply goods, provide services, or carry out the works needed for humanitarian programs, thereby strengthening local partnership, supporting the national economy, and ensuring the continuity of services.

translations.word: Local Companies|National institutions and companies operating in the beneficiary country that are contracted to supply goods, provide services, or carry out the works needed for humanitarian programs, thereby strengthening local partnership, supporting the national economy, and ensuring the continuity of services.

records.definition: معيار دولي يحدد متطلبات إنشاء نظام إدارة الامتثال الفعال في المنظمات وتطويره وتنفيذه وتقييمه وصيانته وتحسينه، ويساعد المنظمات على الالتزام بجميع القوانين والأنظمة والمعايير والمتطلبات التنظيمية والسياسات الداخلية ذات الصلة بأنشطتها، ويعزز المعيار ثقافة الامتثال المؤسسي، ويقلل من مخاطر عدم الالتزام القانوني والتنظيمي، ويحمي سمعة المنظمة ومصالح أصحاب المصلحة.
records.english_definition: An international standard that specifies the requirements for establishing, developing, implementing, evaluating, maintaining, and improving an effective compliance management system in organizations. It helps organizations comply with all laws, regulations, standards, regulatory requirements, and internal policies relevant to their activities. The standard fosters a culture of institutional compliance, reduces the risks of legal and regulatory non-compliance, and protects the organization's reputation and the interests of stakeholders.

translations.word: ISO Certification for Compliance Management|An international standard that specifies the requirements for establishing, developing, implementing, evaluating, maintaining, and improving an effective compliance management system in organizations. It helps organizations comply with all laws, regulations, standards, regulatory requirements, and internal policies relevant to their activities. The standard fosters a culture of institutional compliance, reduces the risks of legal and regulatory non-compliance, and protects the organization's reputation and the interests of stakeholders.

records.definition: معيار دولي يوفر مبادئ وإرشادات عامة لإدارة المخاطر في المنظمات، يهدف إلى مساعدة المنظمات على تطوير نهج منهجي لتحديد المخاطر وتقييمها ومعالجتها التي قد تؤثر على تحقيق أهدافها الإستراتيجية والتشغيلية. يركز المعيار على دمج إدارة المخاطر في جميع أنشطة المنظمة وثقافتها التنظيمية؛ مما يساعد في اتخاذ قرارات أفضل، وتحسين النتائج، وحماية القيمة المؤسسية.
records.english_definition: An international standard providing general principles and guidelines for risk management in organizations. It aims to help organizations develop a systematic approach to identifying, assessing, and treating the risks that may affect the achievement of their strategic and operational objectives. The standard focuses on integrating risk management into all of the organization's activities and its organizational culture, thereby supporting better decision-making, improving outcomes, and protecting institutional value.

translations.word: ISO Certification for Risk Management|An international standard providing general principles and guidelines for risk management in organizations. It aims to help organizations develop a systematic approach to identifying, assessing, and treating the risks that may affect the achievement of their strategic and operational objectives. The standard focuses on integrating risk management into all of the organization's activities and its organizational culture, thereby supporting better decision-making, improving outcomes, and protecting institutional value.

records.definition: معيار دولي يوفر مبادئ توجيهية شاملة لحوكمة المنظمات بمختلف أنواعها وأحجامها، يهدف إلى تعزيز الممارسات الجيدة في الحوكمة، من خلال توفير إطار عمل للإشراف الفعال والمساءلة والشفافية واتخاذ القرارات الأخلاقية. يساعد المعيار المنظمات على تحقيق أهدافها بطريقة مسؤولة ومستدامة، مع مراعاة مصالح جميع أصحاب المصلحة، ويعزز الثقة والمصداقية في إدارة المؤسسات.
records.english_definition: An international standard providing comprehensive guidelines for the governance of organizations of all types and sizes. It aims to promote good governance practices by providing a framework for effective oversight, accountability, transparency, and ethical decision-making. The standard helps organizations achieve their objectives in a responsible and sustainable manner, taking into account the interests of all stakeholders, and enhances trust and credibility in the management of institutions.

translations.word: ISO Certification for Organizational Governance|An international standard providing comprehensive guidelines for the governance of organizations of all types and sizes. It aims to promote good governance practices by providing a framework for effective oversight, accountability, transparency, and ethical decision-making. The standard helps organizations achieve their objectives in a responsible and sustainable manner, taking into account the interests of all stakeholders, and enhances trust and credibility in the management of institutions.

records.definition: القضايا والاعتبارات المتعلقة بحماية البيئة الطبيعية، والحفاظ على الموارد البيئية أثناء تنفيذ البرامج والمشاريع الإنسانية، والعمل على تقليل الآثار السلبية للتدخلات على النظم البيئية، مع تعزيز الممارسات المستدامة التي تحمي البيئة للأجيال القادمة.
records.english_definition: The issues and considerations related to protecting the natural environment and preserving environmental resources during the implementation of humanitarian programs and projects, working to minimize the negative effects of interventions on ecosystems, while promoting sustainable practices that protect the environment for future generations.

translations.word: Environmental Concerns|The issues and considerations related to protecting the natural environment and preserving environmental resources during the implementation of humanitarian programs and projects, working to minimize the negative effects of interventions on ecosystems, while promoting sustainable practices that protect the environment for future generations.

records.definition: الجوهر الأساسي للعمل الإنساني المتمثل في مبادئ الإنسانية والحياد وعدم الانحياز والاستقلالية.
records.english_definition: The essential core of humanitarian action, embodied in the principles of humanity, neutrality, impartiality, and independence.

translations.word: The Core of Humanitarian Action|The essential core of humanitarian action, embodied in the principles of humanity, neutrality, impartiality, and independence.

records.definition: صندوق يركِّز على الاستثمارات التي تحقِّق عوائد مالية وتأثيرًا اجتماعيًّا إيجابيًّا.
records.english_definition: A fund focusing on investments that generate financial returns and positive social impact.

translations.word: Social Investment Fund|A fund focusing on investments that generate financial returns and positive social impact.

records.definition: صندوق مخصَّص لدعم تطوير التعليم من خلال التمويل المبتكر للمبادرات التعليمية.
records.english_definition: A fund dedicated to supporting education development through innovative financing.

translations.word: Education Investment Fund|A fund dedicated to supporting education development through innovative financing.

records.definition: صندوق يموِّل مشاريع لتعزيز الأمن الغذائي ومكافحة الجوع.
records.english_definition: A fund financing projects to enhance food security and fight hunger.

translations.word: Food Security Fund|A fund financing projects to enhance food security and fight hunger.

records.definition: صندوق يموِّل تطوير مشاريع البنية التحتية مثل الطرق والطاقة والمياه.
records.english_definition: A fund financing the development of infrastructure projects like roads, energy, and water.

translations.word: Infrastructure Fund|A fund financing the development of infrastructure projects like roads, energy, and water.

records.definition: صندوق مالي وطني يجمع التبرعات من مصادر متعددة ويوزعها على المشاريع الإنسانية ذات الأولوية؛ بناءً على معايير موضوعية.
records.english_definition: A national fund that pools donations from multiple sources and allocates them to priority humanitarian projects based on objective criteria.

translations.word: Humanitarian Financing Fund|A national fund that pools donations from multiple sources and allocates them to priority humanitarian projects based on objective criteria.

records.definition: صندوق يقدِّم قروضًا صغيرة لدعم الأفراد المنخفضي الدخل في إنشاء مشاريعهم.
records.english_definition: A fund providing small loans to low-income individuals to support entrepreneurship.

translations.word: Microfinance Fund|A fund providing small loans to low-income individuals to support entrepreneurship.

records.definition: صندوق يموِّل مشاريع تعزِّز الأبعاد الاقتصادية والاجتماعية والبيئية للتنمية.
records.english_definition: A fund that finances projects promoting economic, social, and environmental sustainability.

translations.word: Sustainable Development Fund|A fund that finances projects promoting economic, social, and environmental sustainability.

records.definition: صندوق يعزِّز التعاون بين الدول لتنفيذ برامج ومشاريع تنموية مشتركة.
records.english_definition: A fund enhancing cooperation among countries to implement joint development programs and projects.

translations.word: International Partnership Fund|A fund enhancing cooperation among countries to implement joint development programs and projects.

records.definition: آلية دولية لتمويل المبادرات الصحية ومكافحة الأوبئة والأمراض.
records.english_definition: An international mechanism financing health initiatives and combating epidemics and diseases.

translations.word: Global Health Fund|An international mechanism financing health initiatives and combating epidemics and diseases.

records.definition: صندوق يُستخدم لتقديم استجابات مالية عاجلة للأزمات والكوارث.
records.english_definition: A fund used to provide rapid financial responses to crises and disasters.

translations.word: Emergency Fund|A fund used to provide rapid financial responses to crises and disasters.

records.definition: صندوق يدعم برامج تمكين النساء اقتصاديًّا واجتماعيًّا.
records.english_definition: A fund supporting programs that economically and socially empower women.

translations.word: Women’s Empowerment Fund|A fund supporting programs that economically and socially empower women.

records.definition: صندوق يموِّل المشاريع التي تهدف إلى حماية الموارد الطبيعية والحفاظ على البيئة.
records.english_definition: A fund that finances projects aimed at protecting natural resources and preserving the environment.

translations.word: Environmental Protection Fund|A fund that finances projects aimed at protecting natural resources and preserving the environment.

records.definition: صندوق يستثمر في الأفكار والمشاريع المبتكرة لتحقيق التنمية المستدامة.
records.english_definition: A fund investing in innovative ideas and projects for sustainable development.

translations.word: Innovation Support Fund|A fund investing in innovative ideas and projects for sustainable development.

records.definition: هيئة تقدم تمويلًا ميسَّرًا لدعم نمو المشروعات الصغيرة والمتوسطة.
records.english_definition: An entity providing affordable financing to support the growth of SMEs.

translations.word: Small and Medium Enterprise (SME) Fund|An entity providing affordable financing to support the growth of SMEs.

records.definition: صندوق يستثمر في الشركات الناشئة العالية المخاطر ذات النمو المحتمل الكبير.
records.english_definition: A fund investing in high-risk, high-growth potential startups.

translations.word: Venture Capital Fund|A fund investing in high-risk, high-growth potential startups.

records.definition: العملية التي يتم من خلالها تطوير وتبني السياسات العامة.
records.english_definition: The process through which public policies are developed and adopted.

translations.word: Policy-Making|The process through which public policies are developed and adopted.

records.definition: إشراك مجموعة واسعة من الأطراف في اتخاذ القرارات الهامة.
records.english_definition: Involving a wide range of stakeholders in making important decisions.

translations.word: Participatory Decision-Making|Involving a wide range of stakeholders in making important decisions.

records.definition: الأفراد والأسر والمجتمعات الذين تعرضوا لأضرار جسدية أو نفسية أو مادية نتيجة الكوارث الطبيعية كالزلازل والفيضانات والأعاصير أو الكوارث البشرية كالنزاعات المسلحة والحوادث الصناعية، الذين يحتاجون إلى دعم ومساعدة عاجلة لإنقاذ حياتهم، وإعادة بناء حياتهم.
records.english_definition: Individuals, families, and communities who have suffered physical, psychological, or material harm as a result of natural disasters — such as earthquakes, floods, and hurricanes — or man-made disasters — such as armed conflicts and industrial accidents — and who need urgent support and assistance to save their lives and rebuild their lives.

translations.word: Disaster Victims|Individuals, families, and communities who have suffered physical, psychological, or material harm as a result of natural disasters — such as earthquakes, floods, and hurricanes — or man-made disasters — such as armed conflicts and industrial accidents — and who need urgent support and assistance to save their lives and rebuild their lives.

records.definition: مبدأ يقتضي أن الحق في تلقي المساعدة الإنسانية ومنحها مبدأ إنسانيًّا أساسيًّا يجب أن يتمتع به جميع المواطنين في جميع البلدان، ويأتي في المقام الأول.
records.english_definition: A principle stipulating that the right to receive and to offer humanitarian assistance is a fundamental humanitarian principle that all citizens in all countries must enjoy, and that it comes first and foremost.

translations.word: Humanitarian Imperative|A principle stipulating that the right to receive and to offer humanitarian assistance is a fundamental humanitarian principle that all citizens in all countries must enjoy, and that it comes first and foremost.

records.definition: توفير بيئة آمنة للمتضررين تحميهم من المخاطر الجسدية والصحية والأمنية في سياق الأزمات الإنسانية.
records.english_definition: Providing a safe environment for affected people that protects them from physical, health, and security risks in the context of humanitarian crises.

translations.word: Ensuring Public Safety|Providing a safe environment for affected people that protects them from physical, health, and security risks in the context of humanitarian crises.

records.definition: الحماية القانونية الممنوحة لأشخاص أو منظمات معينة من الخضوع للولاية القضائية أو الإجراءات القانونية، بهدف تمكينهم من أداء مهامهم بحرية واستقلالية، وتشمل الحصانة الدبلوماسية وحصانة موظفي المنظمات الدولية.
records.english_definition: The legal protection granted to certain persons or organizations against being subject to jurisdiction or legal proceedings, in order to enable them to perform their functions freely and independently, including diplomatic immunity and the immunity of officials of international organizations.

translations.word: Fundamental Guarantees|The legal protection granted to certain persons or organizations against being subject to jurisdiction or legal proceedings, in order to enable them to perform their functions freely and independently, including diplomatic immunity and the immunity of officials of international organizations.

records.definition: حس خلاقي ووجداني يدفع الأفراد والمجتمعات إلى التضامن مع المتضررين، وتقديم المساعدة لهم.
records.english_definition: A moral and emotional sense that drives individuals and communities to stand in solidarity with those affected and to provide them with assistance.

translations.word: Human Conscience|A moral and emotional sense that drives individuals and communities to stand in solidarity with those affected and to provide them with assistance.

records.definition: الصفة التي تتميز بها الأعمال الموجَّهة لتخفيف معاناة البشر، وحماية الحياة والصحة، واحترام الكرامة الإنسانية.
records.english_definition: The quality that characterizes actions directed at alleviating human suffering, protecting life and health, and respecting human dignity.

translations.word: Humanitarian Character|The quality that characterizes actions directed at alleviating human suffering, protecting life and health, and respecting human dignity.

records.definition: الأشخاص الذين فروا من بلادهم وتقدموا بطلب رسمي للحصول على صفة اللاجئ، ولم يتم البت في طلباتهم بعد، ويتمتعون بحماية مؤقتة بموجب القانون الدولي.
records.english_definition: Persons who have fled their countries and formally applied for refugee status, whose applications have not yet been decided, and who enjoy temporary protection under international law.

translations.word: Asylum Seekers|Persons who have fled their countries and formally applied for refugee status, whose applications have not yet been decided, and who enjoy temporary protection under international law.

records.definition: الموظف أو الشخص الذي يقدِّم خدماته، ويؤدي مهام محددة ضمن منظمة أو مشروع إنساني مقابل أجر متفق عليه، ويسهم بمهاراته وخبراته في تحقيق أهداف العمل الإنساني وفقًا لمعايير مهنية وأخلاقية محددة.
records.english_definition: An employee or person who provides their services and performs specific tasks within a humanitarian organization or project in return for an agreed wage, and who contributes their skills and expertise to achieving the objectives of humanitarian work in accordance with defined professional and ethical standards.

translations.word: Worker|An employee or person who provides their services and performs specific tasks within a humanitarian organization or project in return for an agreed wage, and who contributes their skills and expertise to achieving the objectives of humanitarian work in accordance with defined professional and ethical standards.

records.definition: أشخاص كانوا لاجئين أو نازحين وعادوا طوعًا إلى مناطق إقامتهم الأصلية بعد زوال أسباب النزوح، ويحتاجون إلى دعم لإعادة الاندماج.
records.english_definition: Persons who were refugees or displaced and have voluntarily returned to their areas of original residence after the causes of displacement have ceased, and who need support for reintegration.

translations.word: Returnees|Persons who were refugees or displaced and have voluntarily returned to their areas of original residence after the causes of displacement have ceased, and who need support for reintegration.

records.definition: المبدأ الأخلاقي الأساسي الذي يحظر الاستفادة بأي شكل من ضعف المستفيدين من المساعدات الإنسانية أو حاجتهم سواءً جنسيًّا أو ماديًّا أو معنويًّا، ويلزم العاملين في المجال الإنساني بحماية كرامة المستفيدين وصون حقوقهم، ومعاملتهم باحترام كامل.
records.english_definition: The fundamental ethical principle that prohibits taking advantage in any way of the vulnerability or need of humanitarian aid beneficiaries — whether sexually, materially, or morally — and that obliges humanitarian workers to protect the dignity of beneficiaries, safeguard their rights, and treat them with full respect.

translations.word: Non-Exploitation of Beneficiaries|The fundamental ethical principle that prohibits taking advantage in any way of the vulnerability or need of humanitarian aid beneficiaries — whether sexually, materially, or morally — and that obliges humanitarian workers to protect the dignity of beneficiaries, safeguard their rights, and treat them with full respect.

records.definition: مبدأ يقضي بضرورة أن تكون التدخلات الإنسانية حساسة للسياق، وألا تؤدي إلى تفاقم النزاعات أو خلق أضرار جديدة.
records.english_definition: A principle requiring development interventions to be designed and implemented in ways that avoid causing unintended harm, exacerbating conflict, or increasing vulnerability and inequality.

translations.word: Do No Harm |  A principle requiring development interventions to be designed and implemented in ways that avoid causing unintended harm, exacerbating conflict, or increasing vulnerability and inequality.

records.definition: عدم استخدام المعونة لدعم موقف سياسي أو عسكري بعينه، بحيث تُمنح المعونة الإنسانية أو الإغاثية وفقًا لاحتياجات الأفراد والأسر والمجتمعات والشعوب.
records.english_definition: Not using aid to support a particular political or military position, so that humanitarian or relief aid is granted according to the needs of individuals, families, communities, and peoples.

translations.word: Neutrality|Not using aid to support a particular political or military position, so that humanitarian or relief aid is granted according to the needs of individuals, families, communities, and peoples.

records.definition: مبدأ يكفل تقديم المساعدات الإنسانية لجميع المحتاجين دون تفرقة على أساس العِرْق أو الدين أو الجنس أو الأصل أو الإعاقة أو أي معيار آخر.
records.english_definition: A principle guaranteeing the provision of humanitarian assistance to all those in need without distinction on the basis of race, religion, gender, origin, disability, or any other criterion.

translations.word: Non-Discrimination|A principle guaranteeing the provision of humanitarian assistance to all those in need without distinction on the basis of race, religion, gender, origin, disability, or any other criterion.

records.definition: المبدأ الأخلاقي الذي يُلْزِم العاملين الإنسانيين بتجنب التسبب في ضرر للمستفيدين من المساعدات سواء مباشرة أو غير مباشرة.
records.english_definition: The ethical principle that obliges humanitarian workers to avoid causing harm to aid beneficiaries, whether directly or indirectly.

translations.word: Do No Harm|The ethical principle that obliges humanitarian workers to avoid causing harm to aid beneficiaries, whether directly or indirectly.

records.definition: تعزيز وسائل التنفيذ وتنشيط الشراكة العالمية للتنمية المستدامة.
records.english_definition: Strengthening means of implementation and revitalizing the global partnership for sustainable development.

translations.word: Partnerships for the Goals|Strengthening means of implementation and revitalizing the global partnership for sustainable development.

records.definition: برنامج طبي متخصص يوفر العمليات الجراحية القلبية للأطفال المصابين بأمراض القلب الخلقية أو المكتسبة.
records.english_definition: A specialized medical program providing cardiac surgical operations for children with congenital or acquired heart disease.

translations.word: Pediatric Cardiac Surgery|A specialized medical program providing cardiac surgical operations for children with congenital or acquired heart disease.

records.definition: أنشطة وتدخلات ميدانية منظمة تُنفذ لتقديم المساعدة للمتضررين من الأزمات.
records.english_definition: Organized field activities and interventions carried out to provide assistance to those affected by crises.

translations.word: Humanitarian Operations|Organized field activities and interventions carried out to provide assistance to those affected by crises.

records.definition: استقطاب المتطوعين وتأهيلهم للمشاركة في جهود الإغاثة والأعمال الإنسانية، وإنشاء نماذج فعالة لجمع التبرعات، وبناء شبكة قوية من الداعمين والمتبرعين.
records.english_definition: Attracting and training volunteers to participate in relief efforts and humanitarian work, establishing effective fundraising models, and building a strong network of supporters and donors.

translations.word: Enabling Factors|Attracting and training volunteers to participate in relief efforts and humanitarian work, establishing effective fundraising models, and building a strong network of supporters and donors.

records.definition: العقبات والقيود المتعددة التي تحول دون قدرة العاملين في المجال الإنساني على الوصول إلى السكان المتضررين أو وصول المتضررين إلى المساعدات والخدمات بشكل آمن، وتشمل القيود الأمنية والبيروقراطية والإدارية والجغرافية والسياسية.
records.english_definition: The multiple obstacles and restrictions that prevent humanitarian workers from reaching affected populations, or affected people from reaching assistance and services safely, including security, bureaucratic, administrative, geographic, and political constraints.

translations.word: Barriers to Accessing Assistance|The multiple obstacles and restrictions that prevent humanitarian workers from reaching affected populations, or affected people from reaching assistance and services safely, including security, bureaucratic, administrative, geographic, and political constraints.

records.definition: توفير وظائف تضمن ظروفَ عملٍ آمنةً وأجورًا عادلة.
records.english_definition: Providing jobs that ensure safe working conditions and fair wages.

translations.word: Decent Work Opportunities|Providing jobs that ensure safe working conditions and fair wages.

records.definition: الطرق القانونية لحل النزاعات بين الأطراف المتنازعة.
records.english_definition: Legal methods for resolving conflicts between disputing parties.

translations.word: Dispute Resolution|Legal methods for resolving conflicts between disputing parties.

records.definition: تحقيق أفضل النتائج بأقل تكلفة مُمْكِنة.
records.english_definition: Achieving the best outcomes at the lowest possible cost.

translations.word: Cost-Effectiveness|Achieving the best outcomes at the lowest possible cost.

records.definition: درجة تعرض الأفراد أو المجتمعات للضرر من الأخطار؛ بناءً على عوامل اقتصادية واجتماعية وبيئية.
records.english_definition: The degree to which individuals or communities are exposed to harm from hazards, based on economic, social, and environmental factors.

translations.word: Vulnerability|The degree to which individuals or communities are exposed to harm from hazards, based on economic, social, and environmental factors.

records.definition: الإطار القانوني الذي ينظم تقديم المساعدات الإنسانية عبر الحدود الوطنية أثناء الكوارث والأزمات.
records.english_definition: The legal framework governing the provision of humanitarian assistance across national borders during disasters and crises.

translations.word: International Disaster Relief Law|The legal framework governing the provision of humanitarian assistance across national borders during disasters and crises.

records.definition: المنظومة القانونية المتعلقة بحماية حقوق اللاجئين، وأساسها اتفاقية اللاجئين لعام 1951 وبروتوكولها لعام 1967.
records.english_definition: The legal regime concerning the protection of refugees' rights, founded on the 1951 Refugee Convention and its 1967 Protocol.

translations.word: International Refugee Law|The legal regime concerning the protection of refugees' rights, founded on the 1951 Refugee Convention and its 1967 Protocol.

records.definition: مجموعة القواعد القانونية التي تهدف إلى حماية الأشخاص المتضررين من النزاعات المسلحة، والحد من وسائل وأساليب الحرب.
records.english_definition: The body of legal rules aimed at protecting persons affected by armed conflicts and limiting the means and methods of warfare.

translations.word: International Humanitarian Law|The body of legal rules aimed at protecting persons affected by armed conflicts and limiting the means and methods of warfare.

records.definition: مجموعة المعايير والقواعد القانونية الدولية التي تحمي حقوق الإنسان الأساسية وحرياته في جميع الأوقات.
records.english_definition: The body of international legal standards and rules that protect fundamental human rights and freedoms at all times.

translations.word: International Human Rights Law|The body of international legal standards and rules that protect fundamental human rights and freedoms at all times.

records.definition: مجموعة القواعد القانونية غير المكتوبة التي نشأت من الممارسات المتكررة للدول واعتقادها بإلزامية هذه القواعد، وتكمل القانون الدولي المكتوب في المعاهدات.
records.english_definition: The body of unwritten legal rules that have arisen from the repeated practices of states and their belief in the binding nature of these rules, and that complement the written international law contained in treaties.

translations.word: Customary International Law|The body of unwritten legal rules that have arisen from the repeated practices of states and their belief in the binding nature of these rules, and that complement the written international law contained in treaties.

records.definition: الموارد البشرية والمادية والتقنية والمهارات اللازمة للجهات الإنسانية للاستجابة الفعالة للأزمات.
records.english_definition: The human, material, and technical resources and the skills that humanitarian actors need in order to respond effectively to crises.

translations.word: Humanitarian Capacities|The human, material, and technical resources and the skills that humanitarian actors need in order to respond effectively to crises.

records.definition: قدرات الشعوب والمجتمعات المحلية في حالات الكوارث، والتي تُبنى عليها الاستجابة للكوارث من خلال دعمها باستخدام الموظفين المحليين، وشراء المواد المحلية، والتعاون مع الوكالات الإنسانية المحلية.
records.english_definition: The capacities of local peoples and communities in disaster situations, upon which the disaster response is built by supporting them through the use of local staff, the purchase of local materials, and cooperation with local humanitarian agencies.

translations.word: Local Capacities|The capacities of local peoples and communities in disaster situations, upon which the disaster response is built by supporting them through the use of local staff, the purchase of local materials, and cooperation with local humanitarian agencies.

records.definition: الروايات والشهادات الشخصية للمتضررين من الأزمات والكوارث التي توثق معاناتهم وتجاربهم وصمودهم، وتُستخدم لتسليط الضوء على الاحتياجات الإنسانية، وحشد الدعم، وتعزيز التضامن والمساءلة في العمل الإنساني.
records.english_definition: The personal accounts and testimonies of people affected by crises and disasters, documenting their suffering, experiences, and resilience, and used to highlight humanitarian needs, mobilize support, and promote solidarity and accountability in humanitarian work.

translations.word: Human Stories|The personal accounts and testimonies of people affected by crises and disasters, documenting their suffering, experiences, and resilience, and used to highlight humanitarian needs, mobilize support, and promote solidarity and accountability in humanitarian work.

records.definition: مجموعة الجهات والمنظمات العاملة في تقديم المساعدة الإنسانية والحماية للمتضررين من الأزمات.
records.english_definition: The set of entities and organizations working to provide humanitarian assistance and protection to those affected by crises.

translations.word: Humanitarian Sector|The set of entities and organizations working to provide humanitarian assistance and protection to those affected by crises.

records.definition: المعايير والسياسات التي تحدّد متى وكيف يجب الكشف عن المعلومات المتعلقة بالعمليات والموارد والأنشطة والتحديات في العمل الإنساني، بما يضمن الشفافية والمساءلة أمام المانحين والمستفيدين والجمهور مع حماية خصوصية المعلومات الحساسة وأمنها.
records.english_definition: The standards and policies that determine when and how information relating to operations, resources, activities, and challenges in humanitarian work must be disclosed, ensuring transparency and accountability to donors, beneficiaries, and the public, while protecting the privacy and security of sensitive information.

translations.word: Disclosure Rules|The standards and policies that determine when and how information relating to operations, resources, activities, and challenges in humanitarian work must be disclosed, ensuring transparency and accountability to donors, beneficiaries, and the public, while protecting the privacy and security of sensitive information.

records.definition: مجموعة من المبادئ والمعايير الأخلاقية والمهنية التي تحكم سلوك ممثلي ومنسوبي العمل الإنساني وتصرفاتهم أثناء أداء مهامهم الإنسانية والإغاثية، وتضمن الالتزام بالنزاهة والشفافية والاحترافية في جميع التعاملات.
records.english_term: Code of Conduct and Work Ethics
records.english_definition: A set of ethical and professional principles and standards governing the conduct and actions of humanitarian representatives and personnel in the performance of their humanitarian and relief duties, ensuring integrity, transparency, and professionalism in all dealings.

translations.word: Code of Conduct and Work Ethics|A set of ethical and professional principles and standards governing the conduct and actions of humanitarian representatives and personnel in the performance of their humanitarian and relief duties, ensuring integrity, transparency, and professionalism in all dealings.

records.definition: توجيه وتنسيق الجهات الفاعلة في العمل الإنساني لضمان استجابة فعّالة ومنسَّقة وفق المبادئ الإنسانية.
records.english_definition: Guiding and coordinating the actors in humanitarian work to ensure an effective, coordinated response in accordance with humanitarian principles.

translations.word: Humanitarian Leadership|Guiding and coordinating the actors in humanitarian work to ensure an effective, coordinated response in accordance with humanitarian principles.

records.definition: تحديد وقياس النتائج المترتبة على البرامج التدريبية والتنموية.
records.english_definition: Determining and measuring the outcomes of training and development programs.

translations.word: Impact Measurement|Determining and measuring the outcomes of training and development programs.

records.definition: جمع البيانات وتحليلها لتقييم مدى التقدم نحو الأهداف.
records.english_definition: Collecting and analyzing data to assess progress towards objectives.

translations.word: Performance Measurement|Collecting and analyzing data to assess progress towards objectives.

records.definition: حدث أو سلسلة أحداث تسبب معاناة إنسانية واسعة النطاق، وتتجاوز قدرة المجتمع المحلي على الاستجابة.
records.english_definition: An event or series of events causing widespread human suffering that exceeds the local community's capacity to respond.

translations.word: Humanitarian Disaster|An event or series of events causing widespread human suffering that exceeds the local community's capacity to respond.

records.definition: العبء الثقيل من المعاناة والتحديات الإنسانية التي يتحملها العالم، بما في ذلك الفقر والمرض والنزاعات والكوارث، الذي يستدعي تضافر الجهود الدولية والمحلية لتخفيف وطأته ومساعدة المتضررين في إطار المسؤولية الجماعية تجاه البشرية.
records.english_definition: The heavy burden of human suffering and humanitarian challenges borne by the world — including poverty, disease, conflicts, and disasters — which calls for concerted international and local efforts to alleviate it and to assist those affected, within the framework of collective responsibility toward humanity.

translations.word: The Burden of Humanity|The heavy burden of human suffering and humanitarian challenges borne by the world — including poverty, disease, conflicts, and disasters — which calls for concerted international and local efforts to alleviate it and to assist those affected, within the framework of collective responsibility toward humanity.

records.definition: قيمة ذاتية أصيلة ومتأصِّلة في كل إنسان، بغض النظر عن وضعه أو ظروفه، والتي تستوجب احترامها وحمايتها في كل الأحوال، وتقتضي معاملة كل شخص بالتقدير والاحترام اللائق، مع صون حقوقه الأساسية، وعدم إذلاله أو انتهاك خصوصيته مهما كانت حاجته للمساعدة.
records.english_definition: An inherent, intrinsic value rooted in every human being, regardless of their status or circumstances, which must be respected and protected in all situations, and which requires treating every person with due regard and respect, safeguarding their fundamental rights, and never humiliating them or violating their privacy, however great their need for assistance.

translations.word: Human Dignity|An inherent, intrinsic value rooted in every human being, regardless of their status or circumstances, which must be respected and protected in all situations, and which requires treating every person with due regard and respect, safeguarding their fundamental rights, and never humiliating them or violating their privacy, however great their need for assistance.

records.definition: عملٌ منهجي يُعلي شأن أولويةٍ ما، ويُحرّك الوعي والإرادة والقرار تجاهها، حتى تَحظى بالالتزام والإسناد
records.english_definition: Systematic work that elevates a given priority and mobilizes awareness, will and decision towards it, until it gains commitment and support.

translations.word: Advocacy|Systematic work that elevates a given priority and mobilizes awareness, will and decision towards it, until it gains commitment and support.

records.definition: استخدام الموارد بشكل يقلِّل من الفاقد، ويحسِّن العائد الاقتصادي.
records.english_definition: Using resources in a way that minimizes waste and maximizes economic returns.

translations.word: Resource Efficiency|Using resources in a way that minimizes waste and maximizes economic returns.

records.definition: تحسين أداء سلسلة الإمداد لتحقيق أقصى استفادة بأقل تكلفة.
records.english_definition: Enhancing supply chain performance to maximize benefits at the lowest cost.

translations.word: Supply Chain Efficiency|Enhancing supply chain performance to maximize benefits at the lowest cost.

records.definition: برنامج رعاية اجتماعية طويل الأمد يوفر الدعم المالي والرعاية الشاملة للأطفال الأيتام لضمان حصولهم على التعليم والرعاية الصحية والاحتياجات الأساسية
records.english_definition: A long-term social welfare program providing financial support and comprehensive care to orphaned children, to ensure that they receive education, health care, and basic necessities.

translations.word: Orphan Sponsorship|A long-term social welfare program providing financial support and comprehensive care to orphaned children, to ensure that they receive education, health care, and basic necessities.

records.definition: الأحداث الطبيعية المفاجئة والمدمرة، كالزلازل والفيضانات والأعاصير، التي تسبب خسائر بشرية ومادية جسيمة.
records.english_definition: Sudden, destructive natural events — such as earthquakes, floods, and hurricanes — that cause severe human and material losses.

translations.word: Natural Disasters|Sudden, destructive natural events — such as earthquakes, floods, and hurricanes — that cause severe human and material losses.

records.definition: الكوارث الناجمة عن الأفعال البشرية المتعمَّدة أو غير المتعمَّدة، وتشمل النزاعات المسلحة والحروب والحوادث الصناعية والتلوث البيئي والحوادث النووية أو الكيميائية والانهيارات الإنشائية وحوادث النقل الكبرى، والتي تؤدي إلى خسائر بشرية ومادية جسيمة، وتتطلب استجابة إنسانية عاجلة.
records.english_definition: Disasters caused by deliberate or unintentional human actions, including armed conflicts, wars, industrial accidents, environmental pollution, nuclear or chemical accidents, structural collapses, and major transport accidents, which cause severe human and material losses and require an urgent humanitarian response.

translations.word: Man-Made Disasters|Disasters caused by deliberate or unintentional human actions, including armed conflicts, wars, industrial accidents, environmental pollution, nuclear or chemical accidents, structural collapses, and major transport accidents, which cause severe human and material losses and require an urgent humanitarian response.

records.definition: الأشخاص الذين فروا من بلادهم خوفًا من الاضطهاد بسبب عِرْقهم أو دينهم أو جنسيتهم أو انتمائهم لفئة اجتماعية معينة أو آرائهم السياسية.
records.english_definition: Persons who have fled their countries out of fear of persecution on account of their race, religion, nationality, membership of a particular social group, or political opinions.

translations.word: Refugees|Persons who have fled their countries out of fear of persecution on account of their race, religion, nationality, membership of a particular social group, or political opinions.

records.definition: نظام موحَّد لتوسيم البيانات الإنسانية وتبادلها بين المنظمات، يسهل مشاركة المعلومات وتحليلها آليًّا، ويعزّز التنسيق وإدارة المعلومات.
records.english_definition: A unified system for tagging and exchanging humanitarian data among organizations, which facilitates the automated sharing and analysis of information and enhances coordination and information management.

translations.word: Humanitarian Exchange Language (HXL)|A unified system for tagging and exchanging humanitarian data among organizations, which facilitates the automated sharing and analysis of information and enhances coordination and information management.

records.definition: القواعد التي تنظِّم عمليات وإدارة الصندوق ومسؤوليات الأطراف ذات العلاقة.
records.english_definition: Rules governing the fund’s operations and the responsibilities of stakeholders.

translations.word: Fund Regulations|Rules governing the fund’s operations and the responsibilities of stakeholders.

records.definition: الآلية الرقمية لتتبع وعرض بيانات التمويل والأنشطة الإنسانية على مستوى العالم.
records.english_definition: The digital mechanism for tracking and displaying data on humanitarian funding and activities worldwide.

translations.word: Humanitarian Action Dashboard|The digital mechanism for tracking and displaying data on humanitarian funding and activities worldwide.

records.definition: عمل أو مشروع طوعي يُطلَق استجابةً لحاجة إنسانية مُلِحّة، يهدف إلى تخفيف المعاناة، وحماية الكرامة الإنسانية، وإنقاذ الأرواح، ويتميز بالاستباقية دون انتظار طلب رسمي أو تكليف مُسبق. قد تكون المبادرة فردية أو جماعية، مؤقتة أو تمهيدية لعمل مؤسسي أوسع.
records.english_definition: A voluntary act or project launched in response to a pressing humanitarian need, aimed at alleviating suffering, protecting human dignity, and saving lives, and characterized by proactivity without waiting for a formal request or prior mandate. The initiative may be individual or collective, temporary or a precursor to broader institutional action.

translations.word: Humanitarian Initiative|A voluntary act or project launched in response to a pressing humanitarian need, aimed at alleviating suffering, protecting human dignity, and saving lives, and characterized by proactivity without waiting for a formal request or prior mandate. The initiative may be individual or collective, temporary or a precursor to broader institutional action.

records.definition: مشروع زراعي تنموي يوفر البذور والمستلزمات الزراعية للأسر المحتاجة لتمكينها من الاعتماد على الذات في إنتاج الغذاء.
records.english_definition: An agricultural development project that provides seeds and agricultural supplies to needy families in order to enable them to become self-reliant in food production.

translations.word: Seeds of Life | An agricultural development project that provides seeds and agricultural supplies to needy families in order to enable them to become self-reliant in food production.

records.definition: المبادئ الأساسية الأربعة التي تحكم العمل الإنساني؛ وهي: الإنسانية (تخفيف المعاناة وحماية الحياة والكرامة)، والحياد (عدم الانحياز لأي طرف)، والاستقلالية (العمل بشكل مستقل عن المصالح السياسية)، وعدم التحيز (تقديم المساعدة بناءً على الحاجة فقط).
records.english_definition: The four fundamental principles governing humanitarian action, namely: humanity (alleviating suffering and protecting life and dignity), neutrality (not taking sides with any party), independence (operating independently of political interests), and impartiality (providing assistance based solely on need).

translations.word: Humanitarian Principles|The four fundamental principles governing humanitarian action, namely: humanity (alleviating suffering and protecting life and dignity), neutrality (not taking sides with any party), independence (operating independently of political interests), and impartiality (providing assistance based solely on need).

records.definition: المبادئ والمعايير الدولية التي تنظم استخدام الموارد العسكرية والمدنية الأجنبية في عمليات الإغاثة في حالات الكوارث.
records.english_definition: The international principles and standards governing the use of foreign military and civil defence assets in disaster relief operations.

translations.word: Oslo Guidelines|The international principles and standards governing the use of foreign military and civil defence assets in disaster relief operations.

records.definition: الشخص الذي يقدم وقته وجهده ومهاراته طواعيةً دون مقابل مادي لخدمة قضية إنسانية أو دعم مجتمع أو مساعدة محتاجين، مدفوعًا بقيم إنسانية وشعور بالمسؤولية الاجتماعية، والرغبة في إحداث فرق إيجابي في حياة الآخرين.
records.english_definition: A person who voluntarily offers their time, effort, and skills, without financial compensation, to serve a humanitarian cause, support a community, or help those in need, driven by human values, a sense of social responsibility, and a desire to make a positive difference in the lives of others.

translations.word: Volunteer|A person who voluntarily offers their time, effort, and skills, without financial compensation, to serve a humanitarian cause, support a community, or help those in need, driven by human values, a sense of social responsibility, and a desire to make a positive difference in the lives of others.

records.definition: أشد مراحل انعدام الأمن الغذائي (IPC المرحلة 5)، تتميز بنقص شديد في الغذاء يؤدي إلى الجوع ووفيات واسعة النطاق، وتتطلب استجابة إنسانية ضخمة وعاجلة.
records.english_definition: The most severe phase of food insecurity (IPC Phase 5), characterized by an extreme lack of food leading to starvation and widespread deaths, and requiring a massive and urgent humanitarian response.

translations.word: Famine|The most severe phase of food insecurity (IPC Phase 5), characterized by an extreme lack of food leading to starvation and widespread deaths, and requiring a massive and urgent humanitarian response.

records.definition: نطاق الأنشطة والتخصصات المتنوعة التي تشمل الإغاثة والصحة والمأوى والحماية والتعليم في الأزمات.
records.english_definition: The range of diverse activities and disciplines encompassing relief, health, shelter, protection, and education in crises.

translations.word: Field of Humanitarian Action|The range of diverse activities and disciplines encompassing relief, health, shelter, protection, and education in crises.

records.definition: الشبكة العالمية من المنظمات والمؤسسات والأفراد العاملين في مجال العمل الإنساني والإغاثة.
records.english_definition: The global network of organizations, institutions, and individuals working in the field of humanitarian action and relief.

translations.word: The Humanitarian Community|The global network of organizations, institutions, and individuals working in the field of humanitarian action and relief.

records.definition: مجموع الجهات الفاعلة من منظمات دولية وغير حكومية وحكومات ومجتمع مدني التي تعمل معًا لتقديم المساعدة الإنسانية والحماية للمتضررين من الأزمات.
records.english_definition: The totality of actors — international organizations, non-governmental organizations, governments, and civil society — working together to provide humanitarian assistance and protection to those affected by crises.

translations.word: Humanitarian Community|The totality of actors — international organizations, non-governmental organizations, governments, and civil society — working together to provide humanitarian assistance and protection to those affected by crises.

records.definition: مجموعة المنظمات والمؤسسات غير الحكومية والجمعيات التطوعية التي تعمل مستقلة عن السلطة الحكومية لخدمة المصالح العامة.
records.english_definition: The set of non-governmental organizations, institutions, and voluntary associations that operate independently of governmental authority to serve the public interest.

translations.word: Civil Society|The set of non-governmental organizations, institutions, and voluntary associations that operate independently of governmental authority to serve the public interest.

records.definition: مجموعات سكانية تعرضت لأضرار مادية أو معنوية بسبب الأزمات أو الكوارث، وتحتاج إلى مساعدة إنسانية.
records.english_definition: Population groups that have suffered material or moral harm as a result of crises or disasters and are in need of humanitarian assistance.

translations.word: Affected Communities|Population groups that have suffered material or moral harm as a result of crises or disasters and are in need of humanitarian assistance.

records.definition: نسيجٌ إنساني تجمعه روابطُ الجغرافيا أو الثقافة أو الاهتمامات أو التجارب المعيشة، يحمل تنوعًا داخليًا وهويةً جامعة، ويحضر فاعلًا في التفاعل والتأثير.
records.english_definition: A human fabric bound together by ties of geography, culture, shared interests or lived experiences; it carries internal diversity alongside a unifying identity, and is present as an active agent in interaction and influence.

translations.word: Communities|A human fabric bound together by ties of geography, culture, shared interests or lived experiences; it carries internal diversity alongside a unifying identity, and is present as an active agent in interaction and influence.

records.definition: الهيئة العليا المسؤولة عن السياسات واتخاذ القرارات الإستراتيجية للصندوق.
records.english_definition: The highest authority responsible for policies and strategic decisions of the fund.

translations.word: Fund Board of Directors|The highest authority responsible for policies and strategic decisions of the fund.

records.definition: انظر@(العنصر البشري)
records.english_definition: See@(The human element)

translations.word: Main Driver|See@(The human element)

records.definition: قدرة الأفراد على استخدام التقنية بفعالية وأمان للوصول إلى المعلومات.
records.english_definition: The ability to effectively and safely use technology to access information.

translations.word: Digital Literacy|The ability to effectively and safely use technology to access information.

records.definition: الأشخاص الذين لا يشاركون مباشرة في الأعمال العدائية أثناء النزاعات المسلحة، ويتمتعون بحماية خاصة بموجب القانون الدولي الإنساني من الهجمات العسكرية.
records.english_definition: Persons who do not take direct part in hostilities during armed conflicts, and who enjoy special protection from military attacks under international humanitarian law.

translations.word: Civilians|Persons who do not take direct part in hostilities during armed conflicts, and who enjoy special protection from military attacks under international humanitarian law.

records.definition: المبادئ التي توجِّه سلوك مجلس الإدارة والإدارة التنفيذية.
records.english_definition: Principles guiding the behavior of the board and executive management.

translations.word: Code of Ethics|Principles guiding the behavior of the board and executive management.

records.definition: التدقيق المنتظم للتحقق من التزام الصندوق بالأنظمة والمعايير.
records.english_definition: Regular audits to verify compliance with regulations and standards.

translations.word: Fund Audit|Regular audits to verify compliance with regulations and standards.

records.definition: المراحل المتتابعة للاستجابة الإنسانية: التأهب، والاستجابة الطارئة، والإنعاش المبكر، والتعافي والتنمية.
records.english_definition: The successive phases of humanitarian response: preparedness, emergency response, early recovery, and recovery and development.

translations.word: Phases of Humanitarian Action|The successive phases of humanitarian response: preparedness, emergency response, early recovery, and recovery and development.

records.definition: مؤسسة تركِّز على البحث والتطوير في المجال الطبي.
records.english_definition: An institution focusing on research and development in the medical field.

translations.word: Medical Research Center|An institution focusing on research and development in the medical field.

records.definition: مِرْفَق يقدِّم خدمات العلاج الطبيعي وإعادة التأهيل للمرضى.
records.english_definition: A facility providing physical therapy and rehabilitation services to patients.

translations.word: Rehabilitation Center|A facility providing physical therapy and rehabilitation services to patients.

records.definition: مِرْفَق متخصِّص في إجراء الفحوصات الطبية لتشخيص الأمراض.
records.english_definition: A facility specialized in conducting medical tests to diagnose diseases.

translations.word: Diagnostic Center|A facility specialized in conducting medical tests to diagnose diseases.
