records.definition: مِرْفَق يقدِّم خدمات الرعاية الصحية الأساسية للمجتمع المحلي.
records.english_definition: A facility providing basic healthcare services to the local community.

translations.word: Primary Health Center|A facility providing basic healthcare services to the local community.

records.definition: وحدة متنقلة تقدِّم خدمات الرعاية الصحية في المناطق النائية.
records.english_definition: A mobile unit providing healthcare services in remote areas.

translations.word: Mobile Health Unit|A mobile unit providing healthcare services in remote areas.

records.definition: مِرْفَق يقدِّم خدمات الرعاية العاجلة للحالات الطارئة.
records.english_definition: A facility providing urgent care services for emergency cases.

translations.word: Emergency Center|A facility providing urgent care services for emergency cases.

records.definition: قدرة سلسلة الإمداد على التكيف مع التغيرات والاضطرابات.
records.english_definition: The ability of the supply chain to adapt to changes and disruptions.

translations.word: Supply Chain Resilience|The ability of the supply chain to adapt to changes and disruptions.

records.definition: المسؤولية عن استخدام الموارد الإنسانية بفعالية وشفافية، والالتزام بتقديم التقارير للمتضررين والمانحين.
records.english_definition: The responsibility for using humanitarian resources effectively and transparently, and the commitment to reporting to affected people and donors.

translations.word: Relief Accountability|The responsibility for using humanitarian resources effectively and transparently, and the commitment to reporting to affected people and donors.

records.definition: اعتبار العاملين في المجال الإنساني مسؤولين أمام كل من الراغبين في تقديم المساعدة والمحتاجين إليها أثناء الكوارث.
records.english_definition: Regarding humanitarian workers as accountable both to those wishing to provide assistance and to those in need of it during disasters.

translations.word: Dual Accountability|Regarding humanitarian workers as accountable both to those wishing to provide assistance and to those in need of it during disasters.

records.definition: مواد ومعدات مقدَّمة لتوفير المأوى المؤقت للمتضررين كالخيام والبطانيات.
records.english_definition: Materials and equipment provided to supply temporary shelter to affected people, such as tents and blankets.

translations.word: Shelter Assistance|Materials and equipment provided to supply temporary shelter to affected people, such as tents and blankets.

records.definition: مجموعة من الخدمات والمواد الطبية التي تُقدَّم للمحتاجين، تشمل الأدوية والمستلزمات الطبية والفحوصات والعلاج.
records.english_definition: A range of medical services and supplies provided to those in need, including medicines, medical supplies, examinations, and treatment.

translations.word: Health Assistance|A range of medical services and supplies provided to those in need, including medicines, medical supplies, examinations, and treatment.

records.definition: انظر@(معونة إنسانية).
records.english_definition: See@(Humanitarian Aid).

translations.word: Humanitarian Assistance|See@(Humanitarian Aid).

records.definition: أفراد أو أسر أو مجتمعات  تتلقى المساعدات الإنسانية أو الإغاثية، ويشمل ذلك ضحايا الكوارث والنزاعات والأزمات الإنسانية.
records.english_definition: Individuals, families, or communities that receive humanitarian or relief assistance, including victims of disasters, conflicts, and humanitarian crises.

translations.word: Beneficiaries|Individuals, families, or communities that receive humanitarian or relief assistance, including victims of disasters, conflicts, and humanitarian crises.

records.definition: المواقع أو المخيمات المؤقتة أو شبه الدائمة التي تُنشأ لإيواء النازحين أو اللاجئين أو المتضررين من الكوارث، وتُزوَّد بالمرافق والخدمات الأساسية كالمأوى والمياه والصرف الصحي والرعاية الصحية والتعليم، وفقًا للمعايير الإنسانية الدولية.
records.english_definition: The temporary or semi-permanent sites or camps established to shelter displaced persons, refugees, or those affected by disasters, equipped with basic facilities and services such as shelter, water, sanitation, health care, and education, in accordance with international humanitarian standards.

translations.word: Humanitarian Settlements|The temporary or semi-permanent sites or camps established to shelter displaced persons, refugees, or those affected by disasters, equipped with basic facilities and services such as shelter, water, sanitation, health care, and education, in accordance with international humanitarian standards.

records.definition: برامج مكثَّفة لتسريع نمو الشركات الناشئة في فترة زمنية قصيرة.
records.english_definition: Intensive programs designed to speed up the growth of startups in a short time.

translations.word: Business Accelerators|Intensive programs designed to speed up the growth of startups in a short time.

records.definition: التزام مشترك بين جميع الجهات الفاعلة في المجال الإنساني بالعمل بشكل منسق ومتكامل لحماية المتضررين وتلبية احتياجاتهم، مع تحمل المسؤولية المشتركة عن نتائج الاستجابة الإنسانية وضمان المساءلة أمام المستفيدين والمانحين.
records.english_definition: A shared commitment among all actors in the humanitarian field to work in a coordinated and integrated manner to protect affected people and meet their needs, while bearing shared responsibility for the outcomes of the humanitarian response and ensuring accountability to beneficiaries and donors.

translations.word: Collective Responsibility|A shared commitment among all actors in the humanitarian field to work in a coordinated and integrated manner to protect affected people and meet their needs, while bearing shared responsibility for the outcomes of the humanitarian response and ensuring accountability to beneficiaries and donors.

records.definition: إشراك المستفيدين من البرامج في إدارة معونات الإغاثة، بحيث يشاركون في تصميم برنامج المساعدة وتنفيذه وإدارته لتحقيق الإغاثة الفعالة وإعادة التأهيل المستدامة.
records.english_definition: Involving program beneficiaries in the management of relief aid, so that they participate in the design, implementation, and management of the assistance program in order to achieve effective relief and sustainable rehabilitation.

translations.word: Community Participation|Involving program beneficiaries in the management of relief aid, so that they participate in the design, implementation, and management of the assistance program in order to achieve effective relief and sustainable rehabilitation.

records.term: مشاريع نور السعودية التطوعية لمكافحة العمى والأمراض المسببة له
records.term_without_diacritics: مشاريع نور السعودية التطوعية لمكافحة العمى والأمراض المسببة له
records.definition: مشروع طبي إنساني يهدف إلى مكافحة العمى، وتقديم علاجات العيون للمحتاجين في عدد من الدول مثل: جمهورية بنجلاديش، وجمهورية نيجيريا، وجمهورية السودان، وباكستان، والصومال، وجمهورية النيجر.
records.english_definition: A humanitarian medical project aimed at combating blindness and providing eye treatments to those in need in a number of countries, such as the Republic of Bangladesh, the Republic of Nigeria, the Republic of Sudan, Pakistan, Somalia, and the Republic of Niger.

translations.word: Saudi Noor Project | A humanitarian medical project aimed at combating blindness and providing eye treatments to those in need in a number of countries, such as the Republic of Bangladesh, the Republic of Nigeria, the Republic of Sudan, Pakistan, Somalia, and the Republic of Niger.

records.definition: مبادرة خيرية موسمية تُطلق خلال شهر رمضان المبارك، وتوفر سلالًا غذائية تحتوي على مواد أساسية للأسر المحتاجة.
records.english_definition: A seasonal charitable initiative launched during the holy month of Ramadan, providing food baskets containing basic staples to needy families.

translations.word: Ramadan Food Baskets Project|A seasonal charitable initiative launched during the holy month of Ramadan, providing food baskets containing basic staples to needy families.

records.term: مشروع سمع السعودية التطوعي لزراعة القوقعة والتأهيل السمعي
records.term_without_diacritics: مشروع سمع السعودية التطوعي لزراعة القوقعة والتأهيل السمعي
records.definition: برنامج سعودي يهدف إلى تقديم خدمات التأهيل السمعي ومساعدة ضعاف السمع.
records.english_definition: A Saudi program aimed at providing auditory rehabilitation services and assisting the hearing-impaired.

translations.word: Auditory Rehabilitation Project | A Saudi program aimed at providing auditory rehabilitation services and assisting the hearing-impaired.

records.definition: برنامج طبي شامل يوفر عمليات القلب المفتوح والقسطرة القلبية للمرضى المحتاجين.
records.english_definition: A comprehensive medical program providing open-heart surgery and cardiac catheterization for patients in need.

translations.word: Open-Heart Surgery and Catheterization Project|A comprehensive medical program providing open-heart surgery and cardiac catheterization for patients in need.

records.term: مشروع مسام لتطهير الأراضي اليمنية من الألغام
records.term_without_diacritics: مشروع مسام لتطهير الأراضي اليمنية من الألغام
records.definition: مشروع سعودي إنساني لنزع الألغام وتطهير الأراضي اليمنية، يهدف إلى حماية المدنيين من مخاطر الألغام التي أودت بحياة الآلاف، وتسببت بعاهات دائمة وخسائر اقتصادية.
records.english_definition: A Saudi humanitarian project for demining and clearing Yemeni territory, aimed at protecting civilians from the dangers of landmines, which have claimed thousands of lives and caused permanent disabilities and economic losses.

translations.word: Masam Project | A Saudi humanitarian project for demining and clearing Yemeni territory, aimed at protecting civilians from the dangers of landmines, which have claimed thousands of lives and caused permanent disabilities and economic losses.

records.definition: برنامج صحي وغذائي يهدف إلى تشخيص حالات سوء التغذية وعلاجها خاصةً بين الأطفال، وتوفير الغذاء العلاجي والمكملات الغذائية.
records.english_definition: A health and nutrition program aimed at diagnosing and treating cases of malnutrition, particularly among children, and providing therapeutic food and nutritional supplements.

translations.word: Malnutrition Prevention and Treatment Project|A health and nutrition program aimed at diagnosing and treating cases of malnutrition, particularly among children, and providing therapeutic food and nutritional supplements.

records.definition: الألم والضيق الجسدي أو النفسي أو الاجتماعي الذي يتعرض له الأفراد أو المجتمعات؛ نتيجة الكوارث الطبيعية أو النزاعات المسلحة أو الأزمات الاقتصادية أو الاجتماعية، الذي يهدد حياتهم وكرامتهم وحقوقهم الأساسية، ويستدعي التدخل الإنساني العاجل لتخفيف وطأته.
records.english_definition: The physical, psychological, or social pain and distress experienced by individuals or communities as a result of natural disasters, armed conflicts, or economic or social crises, which threatens their lives, dignity, and fundamental rights, and calls for urgent humanitarian intervention to alleviate it.

translations.word: Human Suffering|The physical, psychological, or social pain and distress experienced by individuals or communities as a result of natural disasters, armed conflicts, or economic or social crises, which threatens their lives, dignity, and fundamental rights, and calls for urgent humanitarian intervention to alleviate it.

records.definition: الشروط التي تحدد الجهات أو المشاريع المؤهلة للحصول على دعم.
records.english_definition: Conditions defining who or which projects qualify for support.

translations.word: Eligibility Criteria|Conditions defining who or which projects qualify for support.

records.definition: التدابير المباشرة لحماية الأفراد من الأذى الجسدي، بما في ذلك توفير ملاذات آمنة ودوريات واستجابة فورية للتهديدات.
records.english_definition: The direct measures taken to protect individuals from physical harm, including the provision of safe havens, patrols, and immediate response to threats.

translations.word: Humanitarian Monitoring Standards|The direct measures taken to protect individuals from physical harm, including the provision of safe havens, patrols, and immediate response to threats.

records.definition: مستويات عالية من الاحترافية والمهنية في أداء العمل الإنساني والإغاثي على جميع أصعدة المجتمع الدولي وفق أفضل الممارسات الدولية.
records.english_definition: High levels of professionalism and competence in the performance of humanitarian and relief work at all levels of the international community, in accordance with international best practices.

translations.word: Professional Standards|High levels of professionalism and competence in the performance of humanitarian and relief work at all levels of the international community, in accordance with international best practices.

records.definition: المساعدات العاجلة والسريعة التي تُقدَّم في أوقات الكوارث والأزمات الطارئة، وتشمل الإمدادات الحيوية والخدمات الضرورية للبقاء على قيد الحياة؛ مثل الغذاء والمياه النظيفة والرعاية الصحية الطارئة والمأوى المؤقت بهدف إنقاذ الأرواح، وتوفير الحد الأدنى من متطلبات العيش الكريم.
records.english_definition: The urgent, rapid assistance provided in times of disasters and emergency crises, comprising vital supplies and services essential for survival — such as food, clean water, emergency health care, and temporary shelter — with the aim of saving lives and providing the minimum requirements for a dignified life.

translations.word: Relief Aid|The urgent, rapid assistance provided in times of disasters and emergency crises, comprising vital supplies and services essential for survival — such as food, clean water, emergency health care, and temporary shelter — with the aim of saving lives and providing the minimum requirements for a dignified life.

records.definition: الدعم المادي أو المعنوي أو الخدمي المقدَّم للأفراد أو المجتمعات المتضررة من الأزمات أو الكوارث أو النزاعات أو الفقر؛ بهدف إنقاذ الأرواح، وتخفيف المعاناة، وحماية الكرامة الإنسانية، وتعزيز القدرة على التعافي، وفقًا لمبادئ الإنسانية والحياد والاستقلالية.
records.english_definition: Material, moral, or service-based support provided to individuals or communities affected by crises, disasters, conflicts, or poverty, with the aim of saving lives, alleviating suffering, protecting human dignity, and strengthening the capacity to recover, in accordance with the principles of humanity, neutrality, and independence.

translations.word: Humanitarian Aid|Material, moral, or service-based support provided to individuals or communities affected by crises, disasters, conflicts, or poverty, with the aim of saving lives, alleviating suffering, protecting human dignity, and strengthening the capacity to recover, in accordance with the principles of humanity, neutrality, and independence.

records.definition: المعايير الدنيا المعترف بها دوليًّا للاستجابة الإنسانية في مجالات المياه والصرف الصحي والأمن الغذائي والمأوى والصحة لضمان حقوق المتضررين في الحياة الكريمة.
records.english_definition: The internationally recognized minimum standards for humanitarian response in the areas of water, sanitation, food security, shelter, and health, to guarantee affected people's rights to a dignified life.

translations.word: Sphere Standard|The internationally recognized minimum standards for humanitarian response in the areas of water, sanitation, food security, shelter, and health, to guarantee affected people's rights to a dignified life.

records.definition: المعايير الدنيا المتفق عليها دوليًّا لتقديم المساعدات الإنسانية بجودة مقبولة في مجالات مختلفة.
records.english_definition: The internationally agreed minimum standards for delivering humanitarian assistance of acceptable quality in various sectors.

translations.word: Core Relief Standard|The internationally agreed minimum standards for delivering humanitarian assistance of acceptable quality in various sectors.

records.definition: الوكالة الأممية المعنية بحماية ومساعدة اللاجئين والنازحين وطالبي اللجوء وعديمي الجنسية.
records.english_term: United Nations High Commissioner for Refugees (UNHCR)
records.english_definition: The United Nations agency responsible for protecting and assisting refugees, displaced persons, asylum seekers, and stateless persons.

translations.word: United Nations High Commissioner for Refugees (UNHCR)|The United Nations agency responsible for protecting and assisting refugees, displaced persons, asylum seekers, and stateless persons.

records.definition: الإجراءات التي تهدف لمنع وكشف ومعاقبة الفساد.
records.english_definition: Actions aimed at preventing, detecting, and punishing corruption.

translations.word: Anti-Corruption|Actions aimed at preventing, detecting, and punishing corruption.

records.definition: الجهود الرامية إلى القضاء على الفقر وتحسين مستوى معيشة الفقراء.
records.english_definition: Efforts aimed at eliminating poverty and improving the living standards of the poor.

translations.word: Poverty Alleviation|Efforts aimed at eliminating poverty and improving the living standards of the poor.

records.definition: الجهة الأممية المسؤولة عن تنسيق الاستجابة الإنسانية الدولية، وتعبئة الموارد والدعوة لحماية المتضررين.
records.english_term: Office for the Coordination of Humanitarian Affairs (OCHA)
records.english_definition: The United Nations body responsible for coordinating the international humanitarian response, mobilizing resources, and advocating for the protection of affected people.

translations.word: Office for the Coordination of Humanitarian Affairs (OCHA)|The United Nations body responsible for coordinating the international humanitarian response, mobilizing resources, and advocating for the protection of affected people.

variants.form: office for the coordination of humanitarian affairs

records.definition: السلوكيات والأفعال المحظورة والممنوعة في العمل الإنساني، والتي تتعارض مع المبادئ والقيم الأخلاقية مثل الاستغلال والتحرش والفساد والتمييز والإهمال، التي يُعاقَب عليها وتستوجب الإبلاغ عنها، واتخاذ إجراءات صارمة ضدها.
records.english_definition: The behaviors and acts that are prohibited and forbidden in humanitarian work and that conflict with ethical principles and values — such as exploitation, harassment, corruption, discrimination, and negligence — which are punishable and must be reported and met with strict measures.

translations.word: Prohibited Practices|The behaviors and acts that are prohibited and forbidden in humanitarian work and that conflict with ethical principles and values — such as exploitation, harassment, corruption, discrimination, and negligence — which are punishable and must be reported and met with strict measures.

records.definition: التطبيق العملي للمبادئ والمعايير الإنسانية في الميدان من خلال تقديم المساعدات والخدمات للمحتاجين، وتنفيذ البرامج والمشاريع الإغاثية والتنموية، بما يتطلبه ذلك من مهارات مهنية وحس أخلاقي وقدرة على التكيف مع الظروف الصعبة.
records.english_term: Practice of Relief and Humanitarian Work
records.english_definition: The practical application of humanitarian principles and standards in the field, through the delivery of assistance and services to those in need and the implementation of relief and development programs and projects, with the professional skills, ethical sense, and ability to adapt to difficult conditions that this requires.

translations.word: Practice of Relief and Humanitarian Work|The practical application of humanitarian principles and standards in the field, through the delivery of assistance and services to those in need and the implementation of relief and development programs and projects, with the professional skills, ethical sense, and ability to adapt to difficult conditions that this requires.

records.definition: تكريس المعايير الأخلاقية الإنسانية وتطبيقها في جميع التعاملات والعلاقات المهنية والشخصية؛ بحيث تكون كرامة الإنسان وحقوقه الأساسية هي المحور الرئيسي لكل قرار وإجراء، مع ضمان العدالة والمساواة والشفافية في جميع مستويات العمل والتفاعل.
records.english_definition: Enshrining and applying humane ethical standards in all professional and personal dealings and relationships, so that human dignity and fundamental rights are the central focus of every decision and action, while ensuring justice, equality, and transparency at all levels of work and interaction.

translations.word: Practicing Humanitarian Values|Enshrining and applying humane ethical standards in all professional and personal dealings and relationships, so that human dignity and fundamental rights are the central focus of every decision and action, while ensuring justice, equality, and transparency at all levels of work and interaction.

records.definition: الأموال والأصول المدنية التي يحظر القانون الدولي الإنساني تدميرها أو مصادرتها، وتشمل المباني الثقافية والدينية والطبية والممتلكات الضرورية لبقاء السكان المدنيين.
records.english_definition: The civilian property and assets that international humanitarian law prohibits destroying or confiscating, including cultural, religious, and medical buildings and the property essential to the survival of the civilian population.

translations.word: Protected Property|The civilian property and assets that international humanitarian law prohibits destroying or confiscating, including cultural, religious, and medical buildings and the property essential to the survival of the civilian population.

records.definition: مناطق جغرافية محددة تتمتع بحماية خاصة بموجب القانون الدولي الإنساني، مثل المستشفيات والمدارس ودور العبادة، ويحظر مهاجمتها أو استخدامها لأغراض عسكرية.
records.english_definition: Specific geographic areas enjoying special protection under international humanitarian law — such as hospitals, schools, and places of worship — which may not be attacked or used for military purposes.

translations.word: Protected Areas and Sites|Specific geographic areas enjoying special protection under international humanitarian law — such as hospitals, schools, and places of worship — which may not be attacked or used for military purposes.

records.definition: أعلى مسؤول في الأمم المتحدة للشؤون الإنسانية، يرأس مكتب تنسيق الشؤون الإنسانية (OCHA) واللجنة الدائمة المشتركة بين الوكالات (IASC).
records.english_definition: The most senior United Nations official for humanitarian affairs, who heads the Office for the Coordination of Humanitarian Affairs (OCHA) and the Inter-Agency Standing Committee (IASC).

translations.word: Emergency Relief Coordinator|The most senior United Nations official for humanitarian affairs, who heads the Office for the Coordination of Humanitarian Affairs (OCHA) and the Inter-Agency Standing Committee (IASC).

records.definition: مسؤول رفيع المستوى تعينه الأمم المتحدة لقيادة وتنسيق الاستجابة الإنسانية الدولية في بلد متأثر بأزمة، ويرأس فريق العمل الإنساني .
records.english_definition: A senior official appointed by the United Nations to lead and coordinate the international humanitarian response in a crisis-affected country, who heads the Humanitarian Country Team.

translations.word: Humanitarian Coordinator|A senior official appointed by the United Nations to lead and coordinate the international humanitarian response in a crisis-affected country, who heads the Humanitarian Country Team.

records.definition: الهيئات والمؤسسات التي تعمل على المستوى الدولي أو عبر الحدود الوطنية، وتضم دولًا أو جهات متعددة، وتهدف إلى تحقيق أهداف إنسانية أو تنموية أو سياسية مشتركة مثل منظمات الأمم المتحدة والمنظمات الإقليمية والمنظمات غير الحكومية الدولية.
records.english_definition: Bodies and institutions that operate at the international level or across national borders, comprising multiple states or entities, and aiming to achieve shared humanitarian, development, or political objectives, such as United Nations organizations, regional organizations, and international non-governmental organizations.

translations.word: International Organizations|Bodies and institutions that operate at the international level or across national borders, comprising multiple states or entities, and aiming to achieve shared humanitarian, development, or political objectives, such as United Nations organizations, regional organizations, and international non-governmental organizations.

records.definition: المنظمة الحكومية الدولية الرائدة في مجال الهجرة، وتعمل على ضمان إدارة إنسانية ومنظمة للهجرة.
records.english_definition: The leading intergovernmental organization in the field of migration, working to ensure the humane and orderly management of migration.

translations.word: International Organization for Migration (IOM)|The leading intergovernmental organization in the field of migration, working to ensure the humane and orderly management of migration.

records.definition: كيان مؤسسي منظّم ومستقل، ذو هيكل إداري وتمويل محدد، يعمل بشكل منهجي ومستدام على تقديم المساعدة والحماية للمتضررين من الأزمات والكوارث والنزاعات، ويلتزم بمبادئ العمل الإنساني (الإنسانية، الحياد، عدم الانحياز، الاستقلالية)، سواء كانت حكومية أو غير حكومية، محلية أو دولية.
records.english_definition: An organized, independent institutional entity with a defined administrative structure and funding, working methodically and sustainably to provide assistance and protection to those affected by crises, disasters, and conflicts, and committed to the principles of humanitarian action (humanity, neutrality, impartiality, independence), whether governmental or non-governmental, local or international.

translations.word: Humanitarian Organization|An organized, independent institutional entity with a defined administrative structure and funding, working methodically and sustainably to provide assistance and protection to those affected by crises, disasters, and conflicts, and committed to the principles of humanitarian action (humanity, neutrality, impartiality, independence), whether governmental or non-governmental, local or international.

records.definition: الإطار المتكامل من المبادئ والمعايير والآليات والجهات الفاعلة التي تنظم الاستجابة الإنسانية عالميًّا.
records.english_definition: The integrated framework of principles, standards, mechanisms, and actors that governs humanitarian response globally.

translations.word: The Humanitarian System|The integrated framework of principles, standards, mechanisms, and actors that governs humanitarian response globally.

records.definition: أشخاص يتنقلون من بلد إلى آخر أو داخل بلد واحد لأسباب متنوعة بشكل طوعي أو قسري، وقد يحتاجون إلى حماية ومساعدة إنسانية في حالات الضعف.
records.english_definition: Persons who move from one country to another, or within a single country, for a variety of reasons, voluntarily or involuntarily, and who may need protection and humanitarian assistance in situations of vulnerability.

translations.word: Migrants|Persons who move from one country to another, or within a single country, for a variety of reasons, voluntarily or involuntarily, and who may need protection and humanitarian assistance in situations of vulnerability.

records.definition: المنتجات والسلع والمستلزمات التي يتم شراؤها وتوريدها من السوق المحلي في البلد المستفيد لاستخدامها في البرامج والمشاريع الإنسانية، بما يدعم الاقتصاد المحلي، ويضمن ملاءمة المواد للثقافة المحلية، ويقلل التكاليف وأوقات التسليم.
records.english_definition: Products, goods, and supplies purchased and procured from the local market in the beneficiary country for use in humanitarian programs and projects, thereby supporting the local economy, ensuring the suitability of the materials to the local culture, and reducing costs and delivery times.

translations.word: Local Materials|Products, goods, and supplies purchased and procured from the local market in the beneficiary country for use in humanitarian programs and projects, thereby supporting the local economy, ensuring the suitability of the materials to the local culture, and reducing costs and delivery times.

records.definition: جميع الأفراد العاملين في المنظمة أو الجهة الإنسانية، بما في ذلك الموظفون والمتطوعون والاستشاريون، الذين يشكلون العنصر البشري المحرك للعمل الإنساني.
records.english_definition: All individuals working in the humanitarian organization or entity — including employees, volunteers, and consultants — who constitute the human element driving humanitarian action.

translations.word: Humanitarian Human Resources|All individuals working in the humanitarian organization or entity — including employees, volunteers, and consultants — who constitute the human element driving humanitarian action.

records.definition: تحقيق التوازن بين الأهداف المالية والاجتماعية والبيئية عند تقييم الأداء.
records.english_definition: Achieving balance among financial, social, and environmental objectives when assessing performance.

translations.word: Balanced Performance|Achieving balance among financial, social, and environmental objectives when assessing performance.

records.definition: منتدى دولي رفيع المستوى يجمع الحكومات والمنظمات لمناقشة التحديات، وتطوير السياسات الإنسانية العالمية.
records.english_definition: A high-level international forum that brings together governments and organizations to discuss challenges and develop global humanitarian policies.

translations.word: World Humanitarian Summit|A high-level international forum that brings together governments and organizations to discuss challenges and develop global humanitarian policies.

records.definition: المنظمات غير الحكومية التي تسهم في تحقيق أهداف التنمية الاجتماعية.
records.english_definition: Non-governmental organizations that contribute to achieving social development goals.

translations.word: Civil Society Organizations (CSOs)|Non-governmental organizations that contribute to achieving social development goals.

variants.example: تدعم الحكومة شراكات مع CSOs لتحسين البنية التحتية.

records.definition: مؤسسةٌ تُوظّف مواردها لدعم الأولويات والمبادرات ذات الأثر الإنساني والتنموي، عبر منحٍ ماليةٍ موجَّهة، ضمن إطارٍ مرجعي يُحدّد أولوياتها ومعايير دعمها.
records.english_definition: An institution that channels its resources to support priorities and initiatives of humanitarian and developmental impact, through targeted financial grants, within a reference framework that defines its priorities and funding criteria.

translations.word: Grant-Making Foundation|An institution that channels its resources to support priorities and initiatives of humanitarian and developmental impact, through targeted financial grants, within a reference framework that defines its priorities and funding criteria.

variants.example: تمت الموافقة على طلب Grant-making foundation الجديد.

records.definition: مقاييس تُستخدم لتقييم أداء المؤسسة في المجالات الإستراتيجية والتشغيلية.
records.english_definition: Metrics used to assess organizational performance in strategic and operational areas.

translations.word: Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)|Metrics used to assess organizational performance in strategic and operational areas.

variants.example: أظهرت KPIs ارتفاعاً ملحوظاً في الربع الأخير.

records.definition: مقاييس تُستخدم لتقييم مستوى التنمية البشرية مثل التعليم والصحة والدخل.
records.english_definition: Metrics used to assess human development levels such as education, health, and income.

translations.word: Human Development Indicators|Metrics used to assess human development levels such as education, health, and income.

variants.example: تُظهر بيانات Human Development Indicators تحسناً في مؤشرات الصحة.

records.definition: الكوادر البشرية من أبناء المجتمع المحلي أو البلد المستفيد الذين يتم توظيفهم في برامج ومشاريع العمل الإنساني، الذين يمتلكون معرفة عميقة بالسياق المحلي واللغة والثقافة والعادات؛ مما يعزز فعالية البرامج ويحقق الاستدامة ويخلق فرص عمل للمجتمع المحلي.
records.english_definition: Human resources drawn from the local community or the beneficiary country who are employed in humanitarian programs and projects, and who possess deep knowledge of the local context, language, culture, and customs, thereby enhancing the effectiveness of programs, achieving sustainability, and creating job opportunities for the local community.

translations.word: Local Staff|Human resources drawn from the local community or the beneficiary country who are employed in humanitarian programs and projects, and who possess deep knowledge of the local context, language, culture, and customs, thereby enhancing the effectiveness of programs, achieving sustainability, and creating job opportunities for the local community.

records.definition: وثيقة تحدد المبادئ والمعايير الأساسية للعمل الإنساني وتقديم المساعدات.
records.english_definition: A document setting out the fundamental principles and standards of humanitarian action and the provision of assistance.

translations.word: Relief Charter|A document setting out the fundamental principles and standards of humanitarian action and the provision of assistance.

records.definition: وثيقة تحدِّد المبادئ والمعايير التي توجِّه سلوك الحوكمة داخل المؤسسة.
records.english_definition: A document that sets out the principles and standards guiding governance behavior within the organization.

translations.word: Governance Charter|A document that sets out the principles and standards guiding governance behavior within the organization.

records.definition: وثيقة أخلاقية تحدد معايير السلوك المهني والمبادئ الأخلاقية التي يلتزم بها العاملون في المجال الإنساني، وتضع إطارًا للممارسات الفضلى في تقديم المساعدة الإنسانية؛ بما يضمن احترام كرامة المتضررين والالتزام بالمبادئ الإنسانية الأساسية.
records.english_definition: An ethical document that sets out the standards of professional conduct and the ethical principles to which humanitarian workers are committed, and establishes a framework for best practices in the delivery of humanitarian assistance, ensuring respect for the dignity of affected people and adherence to fundamental humanitarian principles.

translations.word: Code of Honor|An ethical document that sets out the standards of professional conduct and the ethical principles to which humanitarian workers are committed, and establishes a framework for best practices in the delivery of humanitarian assistance, ensuring respect for the dignity of affected people and adherence to fundamental humanitarian principles.

records.definition: قيمة أساسية تعكس السعي لإعلاء الإنسانية وفق مبادئ المواثيق والأعراف الدولية، بحيث تضمن للإنسان في كل مكان بصيص أمل يخفف عنه الألم والمعاناة دون تمييز أو تفرقة
records.english_definition: A core value reflecting the pursuit of upholding humanity in accordance with the principles of international conventions and norms, ensuring that people everywhere have a glimmer of hope that eases their pain and suffering without discrimination or distinction.

translations.word: Humanity Without Borders | A core value reflecting the pursuit of upholding humanity in accordance with the principles of international conventions and norms, ensuring that people everywhere have a glimmer of hope that eases their pain and suffering without discrimination or distinction.

records.definition: حالة عداء عسكري تنشب بين دولتين أو أكثر، وتخضع لأحكام القانون الدولي الإنساني، وخاصة اتفاقيات جنيف الأربع وبروتوكولاتها الإضافية.
records.english_definition: A state of military hostility arising between two or more states, governed by the rules of international humanitarian law, in particular the four Geneva Conventions and their Additional Protocols.

translations.word: International Armed Conflict|A state of military hostility arising between two or more states, governed by the rules of international humanitarian law, in particular the four Geneva Conventions and their Additional Protocols.

records.definition: مجموعة الحقوق والحمايات الدنيا التي تجب كفالتها لجميع الأشخاص في جميع الأوقات دون تمييز، بما في ذلك حظر القتل والتعذيب والمعاملة المهينة، وحق المحاكمة العادلة، والحماية من العقاب الجماعي، كما نصت عليها المادة 75 من البروتوكول الإضافي الأول.
records.english_definition: The minimum rights and protections that must be guaranteed to all persons at all times without discrimination — including the prohibition of murder, torture, and degrading treatment, the right to a fair trial, and protection from collective punishment — as set out in Article 75 of Additional Protocol I.

translations.word: Non-International Armed Conflict|The minimum rights and protections that must be guaranteed to all persons at all times without discrimination — including the prohibition of murder, torture, and degrading treatment, the right to a fair trial, and protection from collective punishment — as set out in Article 75 of Additional Protocol I.

records.definition: حركة إجبارية للأفراد والجماعات من مناطق سكناهم الأصلية بسبب النزاعات المسلحة أو الكوارث الطبيعية أو الاضطهاد؛ مما يجعلهم نازحين داخليًّا أو لاجئين.
records.english_definition: The forced movement of individuals and groups from their original places of residence due to armed conflicts, natural disasters, or persecution, rendering them internally displaced persons or refugees.

translations.word: Population Displacement|The forced movement of individuals and groups from their original places of residence due to armed conflicts, natural disasters, or persecution, rendering them internally displaced persons or refugees.

records.definition: انتقال الأشخاص قسرًا من مناطق إقامتهم المعتادة داخل حدود بلدهم؛ بسبب نزاع أو كارثة أو انتهاكات لحقوق الإنسان.
records.english_definition: The forced movement of people from their habitual places of residence within the borders of their own country, due to conflict, disaster, or human rights violations.

translations.word: Internal Displacement|The forced movement of people from their habitual places of residence within the borders of their own country, due to conflict, disaster, or human rights violations.

records.definition: آلية تنسيق أممية للاستجابة الإنسانية في الطوارئ، تُجمّع المنظمات العاملة في مجموعات متخصصة حسب القطاعات (صحة، مأوى، تعليم...) تحت قيادة وكالة أممية لكل قطاع، بهدف تحسين التنسيق وسد الثغرات وتجنب الازدواجية في الاستجابة الإنسانية.
records.english_definition: A United Nations coordination mechanism for humanitarian response in emergencies, which groups the operating organizations into specialized sector-based clusters (health, shelter, education, etc.), each led by a UN agency, with the aim of improving coordination, filling gaps, and avoiding duplication in the humanitarian response.

translations.word: The Cluster System|A United Nations coordination mechanism for humanitarian response in emergencies, which groups the operating organizations into specialized sector-based clusters (health, shelter, education, etc.), each led by a UN agency, with the aim of improving coordination, filling gaps, and avoiding duplication in the humanitarian response.

records.definition: نظام يجمع ويدير البيانات الصحية لتحسين الرعاية.
records.english_definition: A system that collects and manages health data to improve care.

translations.word: Health Information System|A system that collects and manages health data to improve care.

records.definition: الإطار المفاهيمي والمنهجي لتوضيح الكيفية التي يُتوقع من خلالها أن يسهم تدخل تنموي في تحقيق التغيير المنشود، من خلال تحديد العلاقة المنطقية بين المدخلات والأنشطة والمخرجات والنتائج والأثر، وبيان الافتراضات والمخاطر والعوامل الخارجية التي قد تؤثر في تحقيق هذا التغيير.
records.english_definition: A conceptual and methodological framework that explains how and why a development intervention is expected to achieve the intended change by defining the logical pathways linking inputs, activities, outputs, outcomes, and impact, while articulating the assumptions, risks, and external factors that may influence the achievement of the desired results.

translations.word: Theory of Change |  A conceptual and methodological framework that explains how and why a development intervention is expected to achieve the intended change by defining the logical pathways linking inputs, activities, outputs, outcomes, and impact, while articulating the assumptions, risks, and external factors that may influence the achievement of the desired results.

records.definition: المواقع المحددة التي يتم فيها توزيع المساعدات الإنسانية على المستفيدين بطريقة منظمة وعادلة.
records.english_definition: The designated locations where humanitarian assistance is distributed to beneficiaries in an organized and equitable manner.

translations.word: Distribution Points|The designated locations where humanitarian assistance is distributed to beneficiaries in an organized and equitable manner.

records.definition: عملية نقل المهارات والمعارف من خبراء إلى أفراد أو مؤسسات محلية.
records.english_definition: The process of transferring skills and expertise from experts to local individuals or institutions.

translations.word: Knowledge Transfer|The process of transferring skills and expertise from experts to local individuals or institutions.

records.definition: مبدأ يقتضي تقديم المساعدة بالقدر الذي يلبي الاحتياجات الأساسية فقط دون خلق اعتماد أو تقويض القدرات المحلية القائمة.
records.english_definition: A principle requiring that assistance be provided only to the extent that meets basic needs, without creating dependency or undermining existing local capacities.

translations.word: Minimum Intervention Approach|A principle requiring that assistance be provided only to the extent that meets basic needs, without creating dependency or undermining existing local capacities.

records.definition: التغيرات المتوقَّعة التي تحدث نتيجة للأنشطة المنفَّذة ضمن مشروع أو برنامج.
records.english_definition: The expected changes that occur as a result of activities implemented within a project or program.

translations.word: Outcomes | The expected changes that occur as a result of activities implemented within a project or program.

records.definition: برنامج طبي متخصص يوفر عمليات زراعة القوقعة للأطفال والبالغين الصم مع تقديم التأهيل السمعي اللازم بعد العملية.
records.english_definition: A specialized medical program providing cochlear implant operations for deaf children and adults, along with the necessary post-operative auditory rehabilitation.

translations.word: Saudi Noor Volunteer Project|A specialized medical program providing cochlear implant operations for deaf children and adults, along with the necessary post-operative auditory rehabilitation.

records.definition: الحالة التي يكون فيها الأفراد أو الأسر أو المجتمعات عُرْضَة بشكل خاص للضرر أو المخاطر؛ نتيجة عوامل متعددة كالفقر أو المرض أو الإعاقة أو التهميش الاجتماعي أو النزوح؛ مما يتطلب رعاية واهتمامًا خاصين في تصميم المساعدات الإنسانية، وتقديمها لحمايتهم من التدهور الإضافي.
records.english_definition: The condition in which individuals, families, or communities are particularly exposed to harm or risk as a result of multiple factors, such as poverty, illness, disability, social marginalization, or displacement, requiring special care and attention in the design and delivery of humanitarian assistance in order to protect them from further deterioration.

translations.word: Vulnerability of Beneficiaries|The condition in which individuals, families, or communities are particularly exposed to harm or risk as a result of multiple factors, such as poverty, illness, disability, social marginalization, or displacement, requiring special care and attention in the design and delivery of humanitarian assistance in order to protect them from further deterioration.

records.definition: المنظومة المؤسسية المتكاملة لتنسيق الاستجابة الإنسانية على المستويات العالمية والإقليمية والقطرية، وتشمل IASC وHCT ونظام العناقيد وOCHA.
records.english_definition: The integrated institutional architecture for coordinating humanitarian response at the global, regional, and country levels, including the IASC, the HCT, the cluster system, and OCHA.

translations.word: Humanitarian Coordination Architecture|The integrated institutional architecture for coordinating humanitarian response at the global, regional, and country levels, including the IASC, the HCT, the cluster system, and OCHA.

records.definition: النظام المؤسسي والتنظيمي لتقديم المساعدات الإنسانية، بما يشمل الجهات الفاعلة والآليات والعمليات.
records.english_definition: The institutional and organizational system for delivering humanitarian assistance, including actors, mechanisms, and processes.

translations.word: Humanitarian Aid Architecture|The institutional and organizational system for delivering humanitarian assistance, including actors, mechanisms, and processes.

records.definition: المنظمات والجهات التي تقدم المساعدات والخدمات الإنسانية للمتضررين من الكوارث والنزاعات.
records.english_definition: The organizations and entities that provide humanitarian assistance and services to those affected by disasters and conflicts.

translations.word: Humanitarian Bodies|The organizations and entities that provide humanitarian assistance and services to those affected by disasters and conflicts.

records.definition: جلسات تدريبية تركِّز على التفاعل المباشر بين المشاركين والمدرِّبين.
records.english_definition: Training sessions focused on direct interaction between participants and trainers.

translations.word: Interactive Workshops|Training sessions focused on direct interaction between participants and trainers.

records.definition: القدرة على الوصول إلى السكان المتضررين دون عوائق لتقديم المساعدات الإنسانية، وتقييم الاحتياجات، مع ضمان سلامة العاملين الإنسانيين وأمنهم.
records.english_definition: The ability to reach affected populations without obstacles in order to deliver humanitarian assistance and assess needs, while ensuring the safety and security of humanitarian workers.

translations.word: Humanitarian Access|The ability to reach affected populations without obstacles in order to deliver humanitarian assistance and assess needs, while ensuring the safety and security of humanitarian workers.

records.definition: حالة يعاني فيها السكان من أضرار وحاجات ماسة نتيجة كوارث طبيعية أو نزاعات تتطلب تدخلًا إنسانيًّا عاجلًا.
records.english_definition: A situation in which a population suffers harm and pressing needs as a result of natural disasters or conflicts, requiring urgent humanitarian intervention.

translations.word: Humanitarian Situation|A situation in which a population suffers harm and pressing needs as a result of natural disasters or conflicts, requiring urgent humanitarian intervention.

records.definition: المنظمات والهيئات الدولية أو الإقليمية أو المحلية المتخصصة في تقديم المساعدات الإنسانية والإغاثية، سواءً كانت تابعة للأمم المتحدة أو منظمات غير حكومية أو جمعيات خيرية، والتي تعمل وفق معايير ومبادئ العمل الإنساني الدولية لتقديم الدعم للمحتاجين والمتضررين
records.english_definition: The international, regional, or local organizations and bodies specialized in providing humanitarian and relief assistance — whether affiliated with the United Nations, non-governmental organizations, or charitable associations — which operate in accordance with international humanitarian principles and standards to provide support to those in need and those affected.

translations.word: Humanitarian Agencies|The international, regional, or local organizations and bodies specialized in providing humanitarian and relief assistance — whether affiliated with the United Nations, non-governmental organizations, or charitable associations — which operate in accordance with international humanitarian principles and standards to provide support to those in need and those affected.

records.definition: التدابير الوقائية المتخذة لحماية المدنيين والأعيان المدنية من آثار العمليات العسكرية وفقًا للقانون الإنساني الدولي.
records.english_definition: The precautionary measures taken to protect civilians and civilian objects from the effects of military operations, in accordance with international humanitarian law.

translations.word: Taking Precautions|The precautionary measures taken to protect civilians and civilian objects from the effects of military operations, in accordance with international humanitarian law.

records.definition: مجموعة من المعاهدات والبروتوكولات الدولية التي تنظم حماية الأشخاص المتأثرين بالنزاعات المسلحة والكوارث، وتضع معايير للسلوك الإنساني في أوقات الحرب والسلم.
records.english_definition: A set of international treaties and protocols that regulate the protection of persons affected by armed conflicts and disasters, and establish standards of humane conduct in times of war and peace.

translations.word: Humanitarian Conventions|A set of international treaties and protocols that regulate the protection of persons affected by armed conflicts and disasters, and establish standards of humane conduct in times of war and peace.

records.definition: معاهدات مُلْزِمة قانونًا بين الدول تنظم العلاقات الدولية، وتضع معايير السلوك في مجالات مختلفة مثل حقوق الإنسان والقانون الإنساني والتجارة.
records.english_definition: Legally binding treaties between states that regulate international relations and establish standards of conduct in various fields, such as human rights, humanitarian law, and trade.

translations.word: International Conventions|Legally binding treaties between states that regulate international relations and establish standards of conduct in various fields, such as human rights, humanitarian law, and trade.

records.definition: سلسلة من المعاهدات الدولية المبرمة في مدينة لاهاي الهولندية عامي 1899 و1907، تحدد قوانين وأعراف الحرب، وتنظم سلوك الأطراف المتحاربة وحماية المدنيين والممتلكات.
records.english_definition: A series of international treaties concluded in the Dutch city of The Hague in 1899 and 1907, defining the laws and customs of war and regulating the conduct of belligerent parties and the protection of civilians and property.

translations.word: Hague Conventions|A series of international treaties concluded in the Dutch city of The Hague in 1899 and 1907, defining the laws and customs of war and regulating the conduct of belligerent parties and the protection of civilians and property.

records.definition: اتفاقية الاتحاد الأفريقي لحماية ومساعدة النازحين داخليًّا في أفريقيا (2009)، وهي أول معاهدة دولية ملزمة قانونًا بشأن النازحين داخليًّا.
records.english_definition: The African Union Convention for the Protection and Assistance of Internally Displaced Persons in Africa (2009), the first legally binding international treaty on internally displaced persons.

translations.word: Kampala Convention|The African Union Convention for the Protection and Assistance of Internally Displaced Persons in Africa (2009), the first legally binding international treaty on internally displaced persons.

records.definition: النتائج الإيجابية للتدخلات الإنسانية على حياة المتضررين؛ من حيث إنقاذ الأرواح، وتخفيف المعاناة، وحفظ الكرامة، وتعزيز القدرة على التعافي.
records.english_definition: The positive results of humanitarian interventions on the lives of affected people, in terms of saving lives, alleviating suffering, preserving dignity, and strengthening the capacity to recover.

translations.word: Impact of Humanitarian Action|The positive results of humanitarian interventions on the lives of affected people, in terms of saving lives, alleviating suffering, preserving dignity, and strengthening the capacity to recover.

records.definition: التدابير والخطط الموضوعة مسبقًا لضمان الاستجابة الفعالة والسريعة عند وقوع كارثة أو أزمة.
records.english_definition: The measures and plans put in place in advance to ensure an effective and rapid response when a disaster or crisis occurs.

translations.word: Preparedness Measures|The measures and plans put in place in advance to ensure an effective and rapid response when a disaster or crisis occurs.

records.definition: برنامج العمل والأولويات المحددة للجهات الفاعلة الإنسانية لمعالجة التحديات وتحسين فعالية الاستجابة.
records.english_definition: The program of action and defined priorities of humanitarian actors for addressing challenges and improving the effectiveness of the response.

translations.word: Humanitarian Agenda|The program of action and defined priorities of humanitarian actors for addressing challenges and improving the effectiveness of the response.

records.definition: اتفاقية تحسين حال الجرحى والمرضى بالقوات المسلحة في الميدان (1949)، وهي الاتفاقية الأولى من اتفاقيات جنيف الأربع.
records.english_definition: The Convention for the Amelioration of the Condition of the Wounded and Sick in Armed Forces in the Field (1949), the first of the four Geneva Conventions.

translations.word: Geneva Convention I|The Convention for the Amelioration of the Condition of the Wounded and Sick in Armed Forces in the Field (1949), the first of the four Geneva Conventions.

records.definition: اتفاقية تحسين حال جرحى ومرضى وغرقى القوات المسلحة في البحار (1949)، وهي الاتفاقية الثانية من اتفاقيات جنيف.
records.english_definition: The Convention for the Amelioration of the Condition of Wounded, Sick and Shipwrecked Members of Armed Forces at Sea (1949), the second of the Geneva Conventions.

translations.word: Geneva Convention II|The Convention for the Amelioration of the Condition of Wounded, Sick and Shipwrecked Members of Armed Forces at Sea (1949), the second of the Geneva Conventions.

records.definition: مشروع سعودي إنساني يتبناه مركز الملك سلمان للإغاثة، يُعْنَى بتأهيل الأطفال المجندين والمتأثرين بالنزاع المسلح في اليمن، وإعادة دمجهم في المجتمع، وتقديم الدعم الاجتماعي لهم. انطلق هذا المشروع من محافظة مأرب في سبتمبر عام 2017م.
records.english_definition: A Saudi humanitarian project undertaken by the King Salman Humanitarian Aid and Relief Centre, dedicated to rehabilitating child soldiers and children affected by the armed conflict in Yemen, reintegrating them into society, and providing them with social support. The project was launched in Marib Governorate in September 2017.
